en.name: Abyssal Blade
en.desc:
Active: Overwhelm
 Stuns a target enemy unit for 1.6 seconds. 

Pierces Debuff Immunity.

Passive: Bash
 Grants melee heroes a 25% chance on hit to stun the target for 1.2 seconds and deal 120 bonus physical damage.  Bash chance for ranged heroes is 10%.
notes: The stun is melee range.
Does not stack with other bashes, and does not grant bash to Clones and Tempest Doubles.
Multiple sources of damage block do not stack.
The following heroes cannot trigger Bash on this item: Spirit Breaker, Faceless Void, Slardar, and Kez while in Sai mode.

zh.name: 深渊之刃
zh.desc:
主动：强击
击晕一个敌方目标，持续1.6秒。

无视减益免疫。

被动：重击
近战英雄攻击时有25%的概率击晕目标1.2秒，并额外造成120点物理伤害。远程英雄的击晕概率为10%。
notes: 眩晕的施法距离与近战单位的攻击距离相同。
不与其他重击效果叠加，并且米波的克隆体和天穹守望者的风暴双雄不继承重击效果。
多种伤害格挡物品的效果互不叠加。
以下英雄无法触发该物品的重击效果：裂魂人，虚空假面，斯拉达和双钗模式下的凯。

en.name: Aegis of the Immortal
en.desc:
Passive: Reincarnation
 Brings you to life with full health and mana 5 seconds after you die, at the location where you died. 

Reincarnation must be used within 5 minutes or Aegis of the Immortal disappears. If it expires, it will heal you over 5 seconds (dispels on damage).
notes: Pronounced as ayy jis.

zh.name: 不朽之守护
zh.desc:
被动：重生
死亡5秒后在原地满血满魔复活。

重生必须在5分钟内使用，否则不朽之守护将消失。消失时将在5秒内回复英雄的生命值。（受到攻击将会停止回复）
notes: （英文）读作ayy jis。

en.name: Aeon Disk
en.desc:
Passive: Combo Breaker
 When you take damage and your health falls below 70%, a strong dispel is applied and you gain a 2.5 second buff that provides +75% Status Resistance and causes all damage you deal and are dealt to be reduced to zero. Only triggers on player based damage. Cooldown increases every time it triggers.

Dispel Type: Strong Dispel

zh.name: 永恒之盘
zh.desc:
被动：强断连招
当受到伤害并且生命值低于70%时，会对英雄施加强驱散效果，并且获得2.5秒的加成状态，提供+75%状态抗性，并且所有受到和造成的伤害全部归零。只有来自玩家的伤害才会触发。每次触发后冷却时间都会增加。

驱散类型：强驱散

en.name: Aether Lens
notes: Cast Range bonuses from Aether Lens and Dagon do not stack.

zh.name: 以太透镜
notes: 以太透镜和达贡之神力提供的施法距离加成不会叠加。

en.name: Aghanim's Shard
en.desc:
Passive: Ability Upgrade
Upgrades an existing ability or adds a new ability to your hero.

zh.name: 阿哈利姆魔晶
zh.desc:
被动：技能升级
使英雄升级一个已有技能，或新增一个技能。

en.name: Aghanim's Shard - Consumable
en.desc:
Passive: Ability Upgrade
Upgrades an existing ability or adds a new ability to your hero.

zh.name: 阿哈利姆魔晶 - 消耗品
zh.desc:
被动：技能升级
使英雄升级一个已有技能，或新增一个技能。

en.name: Ancient Guardian
en.desc:
Passive: Ancient Power
 Grants 50 extra bonus damage as long as the unit is within 2000 range of an ancient.

zh.name: 遗迹守护者
zh.desc:
被动：遗迹之力
位于一座遗迹的2000范围内将额外获得50点攻击力。

en.name: Drum of Endurance
en.desc:
Active: Endurance
 Gives +35 attack speed and +13% movement speed to nearby allies for 6 seconds.

Radius: 1200  

Passive: Swiftness Aura
Grants 15 movement speed and 2.5 health regeneration to allies.  

Radius: 1200

zh.name: 韧鼓
zh.desc:
主动：坚韧
为周围友军提供+35攻速加成和+13%移动速度加成，持续6秒。

作用范围：1200

被动：迅捷光环
为周围友军提供15移动速度和2.5点/秒生命恢复。

作用范围：1200

en.name: Khanda
en.desc:
Passive: Empower Spell
 The next Unit Target spell you cast on an enemy deals a separate 250 additional damage, disables their passives, and slows their movement speed by 30% for 4s.
notes: The slow debuff is dispellable.
The break debuff is not dispellable.

zh.name: 绝刃
zh.desc:
被动：法术强化
下个对敌人施放的单体技能会单独对目标造成250点额外伤害，禁用其被动技能，并且减缓30%移动速度，持续4秒。
notes: 减速的负面效果可以被驱散。
破坏的负面效果不能被驱散。

en.name: Apex
notes: Grants +24 to each attribute for Universal Heroes.

zh.name: 极
notes: 对全才英雄提供+24 全属性。

en.name: Arcane Blink
en.desc:
Active: Arcane Blink
 Teleport to a target point up to 1400 units away. 

After teleportation, you restore 250 health and 100 mana.

Arcane Blink cannot be used for 3 seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
notes: Self-casting will cause you to teleport in the direction of your team's fountain.

zh.name: 秘奥闪光
zh.desc:
主动：秘奥闪光
传送到最远1400距离的位置。

传送后回复250点生命和100点魔法。

受到来自敌方英雄或肉山的攻击时，秘奥闪光将在3秒内无法使用。
notes: 快速点击两次会将自己往己方泉水方向传送。

en.name: Arcane Boots
en.desc:
Active: Replenish
Restores 150 mana to all nearby allies.

Radius: 1200

Passive: Basilius Aura
Grants 1 mana regeneration to allies.  

Radius: 1200
Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.
notes: Does not work on Meepo clones.

zh.name: 奥术鞋
zh.desc:
主动：补充
回复英雄周围友方单位150点魔法。

作用范围：1200

被动：王者光环
提升友方单位1点/秒魔法恢复。

作用范围：1200
多个鞋类物品提供的移动速度加成不叠加。
notes: 米波的克隆体不能使用。

en.name: Arcane Ring
en.desc:
Active: Replenish Mana
 Restores mana equal to 30 + 3% of the caster's maximum mana pool to all nearby allies. 

 Radius: 1200

zh.name: 奥术指环
zh.desc:
主动：回魔
使附近所有友方单位回复30点魔法 + 3%施法者最大魔法值。 

作用范围：1200

en.name: Armlet of Mordiggian
en.desc:
Toggle: Unholy Strength
When active, Unholy Strength grants +35 damage, +25 strength and +4 armor, but drains 45 health per second.

 You cannot die from the health drain when Unholy Strength is activated, nor from the strength loss when Unholy Strength is deactivated.
notes: The strength change will affect both maximum and current HP, but you cannot die from the change.
The strength change occurs over 0.6 seconds.
Activating or deactivating Unholy Strength does not interrupt channeling.

zh.name: 莫尔迪基安的臂章
zh.desc:
开关：邪恶之力
开启后邪恶之力将提供+35点攻击力、+25点力量和+4点护甲，但每秒失去45点生命值。

开启邪恶之力后生命流失并不会导致死亡，关闭邪恶之力后力量降低也不会导致死亡。
notes: 力量值的变化会影响血量上限和当前生命值，但是不会致死。
力量的增加将在0.6秒内完成。
开启或关闭邪恶之力并不会打断持续施法。

en.name: Ascetic's Cap
en.desc:
Passive: Endurance
Whenever a debuff would be applied to the owner, grant %status_resistance%% Status resistance and %slow_resistance%% Slow Resistance for %duration% seconds.

zh.name: 简朴短帽
zh.desc:
被动：坚韧不拔
持有者被施加来自玩家控制单位的负面效果就会获得%status_resistance%%状态抗性和%slow_resistance%%减速抗性，持续%duration%秒。

en.name: Ash Legion Shield
en.desc:
Active: Shield Wall
Reduce your own movement speed by 20 to provide a 160 physical damage barrier to allied player controlled targets in a 800 unit radius. Lasts for 6 seconds.

zh.name: 余烬军团战盾
zh.desc:
主动：盾墙
你的移动速度降低20，向800范围内玩家控制的友方目标提供一个160点物理伤害护盾。持续6秒。

en.name: Assault Cuirass
en.desc:
Passive: Assault Aura
 Grants 30 attack speed and 5 armor to nearby allied units and structures, and decreases nearby enemy unit and structure armor by -5.

Radius: 1200

zh.name: 强袭胸甲
zh.desc:
被动：强袭光环
附近友军单位和建筑提升30攻击速度和5点护甲，削弱附近敌军-5点护甲。

作用范围：1200

en.name: Aviana's Feather
en.desc:
Passive: Free Bird
 When equipped hero is below 30% HP, they gain flying movement.

zh.name: 艾维娜之羽
zh.desc:
被动：轻如鸿毛
装备的英雄血量低于30%时获得飞行移动状态。

en.name: Ballista
en.desc:
Passive: Knockback
 Knocks back enemies 50 distance and deals 50 pure damage with every attack.

zh.name: 弩炮
zh.desc:
被动：击退
每次普通攻击都会击退敌人50距离，并造成50点纯粹伤害。

en.name: Skull Basher
en.desc:
Passive: Bash
 Grants melee heroes a 25% chance on hit to stun the target for 1.2 seconds and deal 100 bonus physical damage.  Bash chance for ranged heroes is 10%.
notes: Does not stack with other sources of Bash.
The following heroes cannot trigger Bash on this item: Spirit Breaker, Faceless Void, Slardar, and Kez while in Sai mode.
Does not grant Bash to Clones and Tempest Doubles.

zh.name: 碎颅锤
zh.desc:
被动：重击
近战英雄的攻击有25%的概率击晕目标1.2秒并额外造成100点物理伤害。远程英雄的击晕概率为10%。
notes: 不与其他击晕类技能叠加。
以下英雄无法触发该物品的重击效果：裂魂人，虚空假面，斯拉达和双钗模式下的凯。
米波的克隆体和天穹守望者的风暴双雄不继承重击效果。

en.name: Battle Fury
en.desc:
Active: Chop Tree
 Destroy a target tree. 

Passive: Quell
 Increases attack damage against non-hero units by 10 for melee heroes, and 5 for ranged. 

Passive: Cleave
 Deals 60% of attack damage as physical damage in a cone up to 650 around the target. Deals 40% against creeps. (Melee Only)
notes: Cleave damage goes through spell immunity.
If multiple sources of Cleave are present, each Cleave's damage is applied separately.

zh.name: 狂战斧
zh.desc:
主动：砍伐
砍伐一根指定树木。

被动：压制
对非英雄单位进行物理攻击会造成额外伤害，近战英雄为10点，远程英雄为5点。

被动：分裂
普通攻击时对目标周围最远650距离的锥形区域内敌人造成60%物理伤害。对非英雄单位造成40%物理伤害。（仅近战有效）
notes: 分裂伤害无视减益免疫。
如果存在多个分裂效果，每个分裂的伤害都会单独计算。

en.name:
Black Grimoire
(Warlock)
en.desc:
Use: Profane Knowledge
Hero kills and assists empower the Black Grimoire, granting it charges. Right-click to consume and grant 200 experience per charge. Starts on cooldown. 
This item cannot be dropped.

zh.name:
Black Grimoire
(Warlock)
zh.desc:
使用：异教学识
英雄击杀和助攻会增强黑暗魔典，使其获得能量点数。右键点击后将其消耗，每点能量提供200经验。一开始为冷却状态。
这件物品无法丢弃。

en.name: Black King Bar
en.desc:
Active: Avatar
 Applies a basic dispel. Grants 60% magic resistance and immunity to reflected and pure damage. For the duration of the effect, any negative effect from enemy spells has no effect. 

Duration: 9 / 8 / 7s 
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
notes: Purchasing another Black King Bar will not reset its immunity duration.
Avatar duration is not affected by increases to buff duration.

zh.name: 黑皇杖
zh.desc:
主动：天神下凡
施加弱驱散。获得减益免疫状态。提供60%魔法抗性加成，并且免疫反弹和纯粹伤害。持续时间内敌方技能的负面效果不会生效。

持续时间：9 / 8 / 7秒
驱散类型：弱驱散
notes: 再次购买黑皇杖也不会重置天神下凡的持续时间。
天神下凡的持续时间不会受到增益持续时间增加的影响。

en.name: Blast Rig
en.desc:
Passive: Hair Trigger
 The next time you get attacked by a hero within 400 range, explode dealing 250 damage to all enemies within a 400 radius and causing them to miss 100% of their attacks for 2 seconds.

zh.name: 雷火弹
zh.desc:
被动：一触即发
 一旦被400范围内的英雄攻击就会爆炸，对400范围内所有敌人造成250点伤害，并施加100%致盲效果，持续2秒。

en.name: Blade Mail
en.desc:
Active: Damage Return
For 5.5 seconds, return all incoming damage, increasing the percentage by 85%.

Passive: Damage Return
Everytime you are attacked, you return 10 damage plus 15% of the attack damage dealt to you.
notes: Damage Return is calculated before any kind of reduction.
Returned damage type is the same as it was received.
Damage done by this item is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

zh.name: 刃甲
zh.desc:
主动：伤害反弹
5.5秒内会反弹所有来源的伤害，百分比提升85%。

被动：伤害反弹
每次受到攻击时，反弹10 + 所受攻击伤害的15%。
notes: 反弹的均为减免前的伤害。
反弹伤害的类型与受到时相同。
这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

en.name: Orb of Blight
en.desc:
Passive: Lesser Corruption
 Your attacks reduce the target's armor by -2 for 3 seconds.
notes: Does not stack with its upgrades, Desolator, or Stygian Desolator.

zh.name: 枯萎之珠
zh.desc:
被动：次级腐蚀
攻击将降低目标-2点护甲，持续3秒。
notes: 不会与升级版物品，黯灭或寂灭叠加。

en.name: Blink Dagger
en.desc:
Active: Blink
 Teleport to a target point up to 1200 units away. 

Blink Dagger cannot be used for 3 seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
notes: Self-casting will cause you to teleport in the direction of your team's fountain.

zh.name: 闪烁匕首
zh.desc:
主动：闪烁
传送到最远1200距离的位置。

受到来自敌方英雄或肉山的攻击时，闪烁匕首将在3秒内无法使用。
notes: 快速点击两次会将自己往己方泉水方向传送。

en.name: Blood Grenade
en.desc:
Use: Throw Grenade
 Throw a grenade at the target area. Enemies in the area will take 50 damage on impact, and be slowed by -15% and take 15 damage every 1s for 5 seconds. Radius 300.

zh.name: 血腥榴弹
zh.desc:
主动：投掷榴弹
向目标区域投掷一枚榴弹。区域内敌人被击中时受到50点伤害，减速-15%并且每1秒受到15点伤害，持续5秒。

en.name: Bloodstone
en.desc:
Active: Bloodpact
 Increases Bloodstone's Spell Lifesteal to 60%. Lasts 5 seconds. 

Passive: Spell Weakness Aura
 Enemy units take 10% increased damage from spells. 

Radius: 1200
notes: Spell Weakness Aura does not stack with Veil of Discord's Spell Weakness.

zh.name: 血精石
zh.desc:
主动：血之契约
血精石的技能吸血效果提升至60%。持续5秒。

被动：法术虚弱光环
敌方单位承受的技能伤害增加10%。

作用范围：1200
notes: 法术虚弱光环不与纷争面纱的法术虚弱叠加。

en.name: Bloodthorn
en.desc:
Active: Soul Rend
 Silences a target for 5 seconds. At the end of the silence, an additional 60% of all damage taken during the silence will be dealt to the target as magical damage.

All attacks on the silenced target will deal additional damage equal to 50 if the attacker is a hero, and 25, if the attacker is a creep. Provides True Strike for your attacks and attacks from your controlled units against the silenced target.

Passive: Pierce
Grants each attack a 40% chance to pierce through evasion and deal 60 bonus magical damage.

zh.name: 血棘
zh.desc:
主动：灵魂撕裂
使目标沉默5秒，沉默结束后其间所受伤害的60%将以额外魔法伤害的形式结算。

英雄/非英雄对目标发动攻击会分别额外造成50 / 25点伤害。另外，自身和控制单位对目标发动的所有攻击都拥有克敌机先效果。

被动：穿刺
每次攻击有40%几率无视闪避并造成额外60点魔法伤害。

en.name: Book of Shadows
en.desc:
Active: Shadows
Target an enemy, ally or self. Causes the target to become untargetable from enemies to the caster, but also silenced, muted and disarmed for 4 seconds. Applies a Basic Dispel.

Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
notes: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

zh.name: 暗影邪典
zh.desc:
主动：邪影
以敌人、队友或自身为目标。使目标无法被敌人选中，但也会被沉默、锁闭和缴械，持续4秒。施加弱驱散。

驱散类型：弱驱散
notes: 不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

en.desc:
Active: Endurance
 Gives +50 attack speed and +15% movement speed to nearby allies for 6 seconds. For the first 1.5 seconds allies are immune to slows.

 Radius: 1200

Grants 15 movement speed and 2.5 health regeneration to allies.  

Radius: 1200

zh.desc:

为周围友军提供+50攻速加成和+15%移动速度加成，持续6秒。而且最初1.5秒友军不受减速效果影响。

作用范围：1200

被动：迅捷光环
为周围友军提供15移动速度和2.5点/秒生命恢复。

作用范围：1200
多个鞋类物品提供的移动速度加成不叠加。

en.name: Bottle
en.desc:
Active: Regenerate
Consumes a charge to restore 110 health and 60 mana over 2.7 seconds. If the hero is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.

The Bottle automatically refills at the fountain.

Hold Control to use on an allied hero.

Passive:  Store Rune
Runes can be stored in the Bottle for later use by right-clicking them. Unused runes will automatically activate after 90 seconds.

Using a stored rune fully refills the Bottle.
notes: Bottle is shareable. Stored runes cannot be shared.
Using a stored Bounty or Water rune fully refills the bottle if the bottle was full when the rune was stored; otherwise, it refills two charges.

zh.name: 魔瓶
zh.desc:
使用：恢复
每次使用都能在2.7秒内恢复110点生命与60点魔法。受到来自敌方英雄或肉山的攻击会失去恢复效果。

魔瓶在靠近友方泉水时会被灌满。

按住Ctrl键可以对友军施放。

被动：储存神符
右键点击神符可以将其存入魔瓶内留作备用，90秒后神符未被使用将会自动激活。

使用储存的神符后魔瓶将会被灌满。
notes: 魔瓶可以共享。储存的神符无法共享。
使用储存的赏金或圣水神符后，若储存时魔瓶被灌满时，那么魔瓶还会被灌满；否则将灌至两口。

en.name: Iron Branch
en.desc:
Use: Plant Tree
 Targets the ground to plant a happy little tree that lasts for 20 seconds.

zh.name: 铁树枝干
zh.desc:
主动：种树
 对地面施放，种下一棵快乐的小树，持续20秒。

 Grants 2 armor to allied player units.

向友方玩家单位提供2点护甲。

Grants 25% movement speed when cast on allies, and slows by 25% when cast on enemies. Lasts 4 seconds.
notes: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

zh.name: 凌厉长鞭
zh.desc:
主动：鞭打
对友军使用时提供25%移动速度加成，对敌人使用时减缓25%移动速度。持续4秒。
notes: 不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

notes: Stacks diminishingly with other sources of Evasion.

notes: 与其他闪避效果为非线性叠加。

en.name: Clumsy Net

notes: Spellover has a 0.1s cooldown between overheats.

zh.name: 咒术师触媒

en.name: Consecrated Wraps
en.desc:
Passive: Hallowed
 Gain a charge every 4s, up to a maximum of 3 charges. Upon gaining a charge, your movement speed is increased by 15% for 5s.

Whenever you take damage from a player-controlled source or Roshan, consume all charges to gain an all damage barrier for 5s that absorbs 120 damage per charge (360 max).
notes: Charges cannot be gained for 4s after you take damage from a player-controlled source or Roshan.
Self-damage and HP Loss damage cannot remove charges.
Movement speed buff does not stack.

zh.name: 圣化护服
zh.desc:
被动：神圣化
每4秒获得一点能量，最多为3点。获得一点能量时，移动速度提升15%，持续5秒。

只要受到来自玩家控制来源或肉山的伤害，所有能量都会被消耗，并获得全伤害护盾，持续5秒，每点能量可以吸收120点伤害（最高为360点）。
notes: 受到来自玩家控制来源或肉山的伤害后4秒内无法获得能量。
对自身的伤害和生命流失伤害无法移除能量。

en.desc:

en.name: Crella's Crozier
en.desc:
Active: Rite of Rumusque
 You enter ghost form for 4 seconds, becoming immune to physical damage, but are unable to attack and -30% more vulnerable to magic damage.

Steal 6% movement speed from enemy heroes in 900 range every second. Movement speed steal lasts 2s.

Putrefaction Aura's effect is increased to 90%. All of the lost Health Restoration is redirected to you every second.

Passive: Putrefaction Aura
Reduces nearby enemy heroes' Health Restoration by 30%.

Radius: 900
notes: Ghost form ends if you become Debuff Immune and will have no effect if you are already Debuff Immune.
Shares cooldown with Ghost Scepter and its upgrades.
Putrefaction Aura does not redirect Health Restoration from enemy heroes that are at full health.

zh.name: 克莱拉牧杖
zh.desc:
主动：鲁姆斯克仪式

每秒从900范围内的敌方英雄窃取6%移动速度。移动速度的窃取效果持续2秒。

en.desc:
Active: Guard
 For 7 seconds, grant nearby allied heroes and buildings a 100% chance to block damage equal to 70 plus 2% of the caster's max health value from each incoming attack.

Radius: 1200

zh.name: 致残之弩

en.desc:

Enemy units take 50 magical damage upon landing.
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel

主动：龙卷风

敌方单位落地后将受到50点魔法伤害。

notes: 不能对队友使用龙卷风。

en.name: Book of the Dead
en.desc:
Active: Greater Demonic Summoning

en.name: Desolator
en.desc:
Passive: Corruption
 Your attacks reduce the target's armor by -6 for 7 seconds.

Passive: Soul Stealer
 Desolator gains +2 damage every time an enemy hero dies while affected by Corruption, to a maximum of 30.
notes: Armor reduction works on buildings.

zh.name: 黯灭
zh.desc:
被动：毁蚀
物理攻击将降低目标-6点护甲，持续7秒。

技能范围提升20%，但是现在还会消耗生命值，数值为魔法消耗的35%。

en.name: Diffusal Blade
en.desc:
Active: Inhibit
 Targets an enemy, slowing it for 4 seconds.

Passive: Manabreak
Each attack burns 40 mana from the target, and deals 1 physical damage per burned mana. 

Illusions do not burn mana.
notes: Does not stack with other diffusal blades.

zh.name: 净魂之刃
zh.desc:
主动：阻止

notes: 不会与其他净魂之刃叠加。

 Dispels both the wearer and the target. Enemy targets are slowed for 4 seconds. Allied targets gain bonus movespeed and 40% slow resistance for 4 seconds. Caster is always granted the ally benefit on cast.

Both movement speed reduction and increase start at 100% and gradually decrease to 0% over the course of the buff duration.
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel

Each attack burns 40 mana from the target, and deals 1 physical damage per burned mana. 

Illusions do not burn mana.

移动速度减缓和提升效果在状态持续时间内初始均为100%，并且逐渐减少至0。

伤害输出提升20%。阵亡后这件中立物品会永久失效，而且失去当前附魔。

en.name: Disgraced Regalia

切换后把30%默认最大生命值转化为最大魔法值，或者把30%默认最大魔法值转化为最大生命值。

 The debuff effect on enemies lingers for 8s after leaving the area of effect.

负面状态会在敌方英雄离开该范围后额外粘滞8秒。
notes: 对范围内的敌方单位施加负面状态，他们在隐身状态下依然会显形。

 Causes melee attacks to attack twice in quick succession. The double attacks apply a 100% movement slow for 0.8 seconds on the first strike.

zh.name: 回音战刃
zh.desc:

Active: Soul Release

zh.name: 精之灵器

主动：灵魂释放

可以对地面施放，使其潜伏最多15秒并附着在第一个进入450范围的敌人。对敌方单位施放时造成25点每秒伤害，并且提供敌人的真实视域，与佩戴者全队共享他们的视野。

en.name: Essence Ring

zh.name: 精华指环

en.name: Eternal Shroud
en.desc:
Passive: Shroud

zh.name: 永世法衣

zh.name: 虚灵之刃

获得15%基础攻击力，30攻击速度，持续6秒。

只要敌方英雄在1500范围内阵亡，嗜血渴望的冷却时间就会重置。

立刻炼化一个普通单位，获得160金钱。对中立生物使用时，在允许的情况下会掉落一包狂石。

无法用于远古单位。
notes: 获得的金钱属于不可靠金钱（不会得到击杀该单位的正常金钱）。
使用炼金获得的经验不会与他人共享。

en.name: Harmonizer
en.desc:
Passive: Balance
 Gain 7% spell mana cost reduction for every ability off cooldown and 6% spell amplification for every ability on cooldown.
notes: Only considers abilities that are visible and have a cooldown.

zh.name: 协和
zh.desc:
被动：均衡
每个不在冷却的英雄技能提供7%魔法消耗降低，每个在冷却的技能提供6%技能增强。
notes: 只会计算可见的技能和拥有冷却时间的技能。

en.name: Harpoon
en.desc:
Active: Draw Forth
 When targeting an enemy, fire a harpoon at them, that pulls you and the target closer together, up to 35% of the distance between you and your target. If the caster is melee, the hero and target are always pulled to within melee distance of each other. Targeting a tree always pulls you all the way to that tree.

Passive: Echo Strike
 Causes melee attacks to attack twice in quick succession. The double attacks apply a 100% movement slow for 1 seconds on the first strike. Echo Strike cooldown: 5s

zh.name: 鱼叉
zh.desc:
主动：钩捕
对敌人使用时向其发射一支鱼叉，将自身和目标牵引到更近的位置，最多牵引自身与目标之间距离的35%。近战英雄总是将目标牵引至他们的攻击距离。以树木为目标总是会把自身牵引至该树木。

被动：回音一击
近战攻击可以快速攻击两次。两次攻击都将减缓100%移动速度，第一次持续1秒。回音一击冷却时间：5秒

en.name: Havoc Hammer
en.desc:
Active: Havoc
 Pulls enemies in a 400 range around you, slowing them by 50% for 3 seconds and dealing 175 + 1.5x your str as magical damage.

zh.name: 浩劫巨锤
zh.desc:
主动：浩劫
牵引自己身边400范围内的敌人，造成50%减速，持续3秒，并造成175 + 1.5 x 自身力量值的魔法伤害。

en.name: Headdress
en.desc:
Passive: Regeneration Aura
Grants 2 health regeneration to allies.

Radius: 1200

zh.name: 恢复头巾
zh.desc:
被动：恢复光环
提升友方单位2点/秒生命恢复。

作用范围：1200

en.name: Heart of Tarrasque
en.desc:
Passive: Behemoth's Blood
Your health regeneration is increased by 1.5% of your missing health.
notes: Multiple instances of Behemoth's Blood do not stack.

zh.name: 恐鳌之心
zh.desc:
被动：巨兽之血
生命恢复提升缺失生命值的1.5%。
notes: 多个巨兽之血的效果不会叠加。

en.name: Heaven's Halberd
en.desc:
Active: Disarm
Prevents a target from attacking for 3.5 seconds.

zh.name: 天堂之戟
zh.desc:
主动：缴械
阻止目标在3.5秒内进行攻击。

en.name: Witchbane
en.desc:
Active: Cleanse
Dispel all enemies and allies in a 300 unit radius.

Dispel Type: Basic Dispel

Passive: Subjugate
Your attacks deal bonus magical damage equal to 4% of your target's Max Mana.

zh.name: 行巫之祸
zh.desc:
主动：清洗
驱散300范围内所有敌人和友军。

驱散类型：弱驱散

被动：征服
攻击时额外造成4%目标最大魔法值的伤害。

en.name: Helm of the Dominator
en.desc:
Active: Dominate
Takes control of one neutral, non-ancient target unit and sets its movement speed to 370 and max health to a minimum of 1000. Also provides the unit with +25 base attack damage, +12 health regen, +4 mana regen and +4 armor. 

Dominated units with a max health of greater than 1000 retain their original max health. Grants the caster 50% of the gold and experience bounty of the dominated creep. Dominated unit's bounty is set to 100 gold and it can no longer be killed by abilities that instantly kill creeps otherwise.

The Helm cannot be used for 3 seconds after the dominated creep takes damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
notes: Cannot dominate more than one unit at a time.  If a new unit is dominated, the old one will die.
Can also Dominate enemy lane creeps and summoned units.
Selling Helm of the Dominator will cause dominated units to die.

zh.name: 支配头盔
zh.desc:
主动：支配
控制一个普通、非远古单位，其移动速度变为370。被支配单位的最大生命值将不会少于1000点。另外还将使该单位+25点基础攻击力，+12点/秒生命恢复，+4点/秒魔法恢复和+4点护甲。

被支配单位的最大生命值大于1000点时将保留原来的最大生命值。施法者会获得被支配单位50%的原击杀金钱和经验。被支配单位的击杀奖励为固定100金，并且不会被秒杀非英雄单位的技能直接击杀。

被支配单位受到来自敌方英雄或肉山的伤害后3秒内无法使用支配技能。
notes: 只能存在一个被支配的单位。如果支配了新的单位，原来的单位将会死亡。
出售支配头盔会导致支配的单位死亡。
出售支配头盔会导致被支配单位死亡。

en.name: Helm of the Overlord
en.desc:
Active: Dominate
Takes control of one neutral target unit and sets its movement speed to 380 and max health to a minimum of 1900. Also provides the unit with +70 base attack damage, +12 health regen, +4 mana regen, +7 armor, and levels up some abilities of the target by 1 level. 

Dominated units with a max health of greater than 1900 retain their original max health. Grants the caster the gold and experience bounty of the dominated creep. Dominated unit's bounty is set to 250 gold and it can no longer be killed by abilities that instantly kill creeps otherwise.

The Helm cannot be used for 3 seconds after the dominated creep takes damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
notes: Can also Dominate enemy lane creeps and summoned units.
Selling will cause dominated units to die.

zh.name: 统御头盔
zh.desc:
主动：支配
控制一个中立单位，其移动速度变为380。被支配单位的最大生命值将不会少于1900点。另外还将使该单位+70点基础攻击力，+12点/秒生命恢复，+4点/秒魔法恢复，+7点护甲并且目标的部分技能等级提升1级。

被支配单位的最大生命值大于1900点时将保留原来的最大生命值。施法者会获得被支配单位的原击杀金钱和经验。被支配单位的击杀奖励为固定250金，并且不会被秒杀非英雄单位的技能直接击杀。

被支配单位受到来自敌方英雄或肉山的伤害后3秒内无法使用支配技能。
notes: 也可以支配敌方线上小兵和召唤单位。
出售会导致支配的单位死亡。

en.name: Helm of the Undying
en.desc:
Passive: Death Delay
 Survive for an extra 6 seconds after receiving a killing blow. If any enemy heroes dies within 1200 units, the death delay effect is extended by 5 seconds. The hero cannot attack buildings during Death Delay.

zh.name: 不朽尸王的头盔
zh.desc:
被动：死亡延迟
受到致死打击后额外存活6秒。如果有敌方英雄在1200范围内阵亡，死亡延迟效果延迟5秒。死亡延迟期间不能攻击建筑。

en.name: Holy Locket
en.desc:
Active: Energy Charge
Target an allied unit to increase their incoming Heal Amplification by 15% for 4s and instantly restore 17 health and 15 mana per charge stored. 

Automatically gains a charge every 10 seconds and whenever a visible enemy within 1200 range uses an ability.

Passive: Holy Blessing
Amplifies heals you provide by 10%.

zh.name: 圣洁吊坠
zh.desc:
主动：充能
使友方单位目标受到的治疗增强提升15%，持续4秒，并且立刻根据能量点数回复相应的生命和魔法，每点能量恢复17点生命和15点魔法。

每10秒自动获得一点能量，每当附近1200范围内有可见敌人施放技能也会获得一点。

被动：神圣福佑
自身提供的治疗效果提升10%。

en.name: Hood of Defiance
en.desc:
Active: Barrier
 Creates a spell shield that absorbs up to 350 magical damage.  Lasts 12 seconds.
notes: Stacks multiplicatively with other sources of magic resistance.

zh.name: 挑战头巾
zh.desc:
主动：绝缘
创造一个法术护盾，可以吸收350点魔法伤害。持续12秒。
notes: 能与其他提高魔法抗性的技能叠加。

en.name: Hurricane Pike
en.desc:
Active: Hurricane Thrust
 Pushes you and target enemy 425 units away from each other, and for 5 seconds, allows you to make 5 attacks against the target without range restrictions and with +100 attack speed.

Can be cast on self or allies to push the target 600 units in the direction it is facing.
Enemy Range: 425
notes: Self-cast will use Hurricane Pike on yourself.
Hurricane Pike doesn't interrupt the target's actions.
Will not work on a unit inside Chronosphere, Duel, or Black Hole.
Attack Range bonuses from Monkey King Bar and Dragon Lance and its upgrades do not stack.

zh.name: 飓风长戟
zh.desc:
主动：飓风之力
 将自己和敌方目标朝相反方向各推开425距离，并且接下来对目标的5次攻击将不受英雄攻击距离的限制，同时获得+100攻击速度，持续5秒。

对自身或友军使用，向面对方向推进600距离。
对敌军施法距离：425
notes: 对自身施法会对自己使用飓风长戟。
飓风长戟不会打断目标的动作。
对时间结界，决斗或黑洞内的单位无效。
来自金箍棒、魔龙枪和升级物品的攻击距离加成不会叠加。

en.name: Hydra's Breath
en.desc:
Passive: Miasma
Attacks poison enemies, dealing 2.5% of the target's Max HP as Magical Damage per second for 3 seconds.

Passive: Polycephaly
Ranged attacks have a 30% chance to fire additional projectiles at up to 3 nearby enemies with 150 extra range and within a 120 degree angle in front of the attacker. The additional projectiles deal 20 + 75% damage of a normal attack and do not trigger on hit effects except for Miasma. The primary attack deals 20 + 100% damage of a normal attack.
notes: Attack Range bonuses from Monkey King Bar and Dragon Lance and its upgrades do not stack.

zh.name: 怪蛇之息
zh.desc:
被动：瘴毒
攻击会使目标中毒，每秒造成目标2.5%最大生命值的魔法伤害，持续3秒。

被动：多头一体
远程攻击有30%的概率向非原攻击目标的前方120度角内、攻击距离+150距离内的最多3个附近敌人发射额外弹道。额外弹道造成20 + 75%普通攻击伤害，并且不会触发瘴毒除外的击中效果。主攻击造成20 + 100%普通攻击伤害。
notes: 来自金箍棒、魔龙枪和升级物品的攻击距离加成不会叠加。

en.name: Idol of Scree'auk
en.desc:
Active: False Flight
 Gain 50% slow resistance, phased movement, and 35% evasion for 6.5 seconds.

zh.name: 丝奎奥克神像
zh.desc:
主动：飞天之幻
提供50%减速抗性、相位移动和35%闪避，持续6.5秒。

en.name: Illusionist's Cape
en.desc:
Active: Create Illusion
 Creates an image under your control. 
Passive: Illusion Mastery
Increases outgoing damage of all units and illusions controlled by the hero by 6%.

zh.name: 幻术师披风
zh.desc:
主动：制造幻象
制造一个幻象，供你驱使。
被动：精进幻象
所有幻象继承的攻击力提升6%。

en.name: Imp Claw
en.desc:
Passive: Critical Strike
 Empowers your next attack, causing it to be a critical strike dealing 130% damage.

zh.name: 魔童之爪
zh.desc:
被动：致命一击
使下一次攻击必定暴击，造成130%伤害。

en.name: Infused Raindrops
en.desc:
Passive: Magical Damage Block
 Consumes a charge to block 120 magic damage from damage instances over 75 damage. 

Comes with 6 charges. When the charges are gone, the item disappears.
notes: Uses at most one charge per damage instance.

zh.name: 凝魂之露
zh.desc:
被动：魔法伤害抵挡
受到超过75点伤害时自动触发，消耗一点能量并抵挡120点魔法伤害。

自带6点能量。能量耗尽后消失。
notes: 每次受到伤害时最多使用一点能量。

en.name: Shadow Blade
en.desc:
Active: Shadow Walk
Makes you invisible for 17 seconds, or until you attack or cast a spell.  While Shadow Walk is active, you move 20% faster and can move through units.  

If attacking to end the invisibility, you gain 175 bonus physical damage on that attack.
notes: Has a 0.3 second fade time.
If the invisibility ends without attacking, the bonus damage is lost.

zh.name: 影刃
zh.desc:
主动：疾影步
进入隐身状态，持续17秒。直到持续时间结束、攻击或施法。当激活疾影步时，移动速度提升20%并能穿越单位。

破隐一击造成175点额外物理伤害。
notes: 拥有0.3秒的进入隐身时间。
如果隐身结束时没有攻击，额外伤害效果将会消失。

en.name: Iron Talon
en.desc:
Active: Chop
Targets a non-player enemy unit to remove 80% of its current HP.

If cast on a tree, instantly destroys it.
notes: Has a 4 second cooldown on Trees.

zh.name: 寒铁钢爪
zh.desc:
主动：砍伐
对非玩家控制的敌方单位使用，移除当前生命值的80%。

对树木施放会立刻将其摧毁。
notes: 对树木使用时冷却时间为4秒。

en.name: Ironwood Tree
en.desc:
Use: Plant Tree
 Targets the ground to plant a happy little tree that lasts for 20 seconds.

zh.name: 铁树之木
zh.desc:
主动：种树
 对地面施放，种下一棵快乐的小树，持续20秒。

en.name: Javelin
en.desc:
Passive: Pierce
Grants each attack a 25% chance to pierce through evasion and deal 60 bonus magical damage.

zh.name: 标枪
zh.desc:
被动：穿刺
 每次攻击有25%几率无视闪避并造成额外60点魔法伤害。

en.name: Jidi Pollen Bag
en.desc:
Active: Pollinate
Spreads pollen on all enemy units in a 900 unit radius for 9 seconds, decreasing their health restoration by 50% and dealing damage per second, the total equal to 9% of their maximum health.
notes: Damage is non-lethal and classified as HP Loss.

zh.name: 基迪花粉袋
zh.desc:
主动：授粉
把花粉播撒给所有900范围内的所有敌方单位，降低50%生命回复，持续9秒，并且在持续时间内造成每秒伤害，总数值为他们的9%最大生命值。
notes: 伤害不会致死，被归为生命损失。

en.name: Kaya
notes: Multiple instances of this item do not stack.

zh.name: 慧光
notes: 多个相同物品不会叠加。

en.name: Kobold Cup
en.desc:
Active: One for the Road
Increases movement speed of all allied units by 10% in a 1000 unit radius around the caster for 6 seconds.

zh.name: 狗头人酒杯
zh.desc:
主动：临行干杯
提升施法者附近1000范围内所有友方单位10%的移动速度，持续6秒。

en.name: Lance of Pursuit
en.desc:
Passive: Hound
 Attacking from behind slows enemies by 16% (8% if Ranged) and deals 20 more damage. Slow lasts 2 second(s).

zh.name: 追击之矛
zh.desc:
被动：追逼
从敌人的身后发动攻击会造成16%减速（远程英雄造成8%减速），并且额外造成20点伤害。减速效果持续2秒。

en.name: Crystalys
en.desc:
Passive: Critical Strike
Grants each attack a 30% chance to deal 160% damage.
notes: Critical Strike does not work against buildings.

zh.name: 水晶剑
zh.desc:
被动：致命一击
每次攻击时有30%概率造成160%伤害。
notes: 在攻击建筑物时不会触发致命一击。

en.name: Morbid Mask
en.desc:
Passive: Lifesteal
Heals the attacker for a percentage of physical damage dealt.

zh.name: 吸血面具
zh.desc:
被动：吸血
攻击者每次攻击都将根据造成伤害的一定百分比回复生命值。

en.name: Light Collector
en.desc:
Active: Lightbreak
 Produce a brilliant flash of light that destroys trees in a 325 AoE. 

Passive: Unclouded
 Provides wearer with health regeneration during the day and mana regeneration during the night. When within a 200 distance of any trees, health and mana regeneration are decreased by 75%.

zh.name: 集光器
zh.desc:
主动：变光
闪现一道强光，摧毁325范围内的树木。

被动：明朗
白天为佩戴者提供生命恢复，夜间提供魔法恢复。200距离内存在树木时，生命和魔法恢复减少75%。

en.name: Lotus Orb
en.desc:
Active: Echo Shell
Applies a shield to the target unit for 5 seconds which re-casts most targeted spells back to their caster.

The shielded unit will still take damage from the spell.
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
notes: Targeted abilities from neutral items do not trigger Echo Shell.

zh.name: 清莲宝珠
zh.desc:
主动：回音之壳
对目标单位施加一个外壳，持续5秒，可以将大部分指向性技能反馈给施法者。

拥有外壳的单位依然会受到技能的伤害。
驱散类型：弱驱散
notes: 中立物品的指向性技能不会触发回音之壳。

en.name: Madstone Bundle
en.desc: Collect to craft new Neutral Items.

zh.name: 狂石包
zh.desc: 收集后可制作新的中立物品。

en.name: Maelstrom
en.desc:
Passive: Chain Lightning
Grants a 25% chance on attack to release a bolt of electricity that leaps between 4 targets within a 650 radius, dealing 110 magical damage to each. Lightning proc pierces evasion.

zh.name: 漩涡
zh.desc:
被动：连环闪电
攻击有25%几率释放一道连环闪电，在650范围内4个目标之间跳跃，闪电将造成110点魔法伤害。触发闪电时无视闪避。

en.name: Mage Slayer
en.desc:
Passive: Mage Slayer
Places a debuff when you attack enemies, dealing 35 physical damage per second and causing them to do 40% less spell damage for 3 seconds.

zh.name: 法师克星
zh.desc:
被动：法师克星
攻击敌人时施加一个负面效果，造成每秒35点物理伤害，并且使目标造成的技能伤害降低40%，持续3秒。

en.name: Magic Stick
en.desc:
Active: Energy Charge
 Instantly restores 15 health and mana per charge stored.

 Max 10 charges. Gains a charge whenever a visible enemy within 1200 range uses an ability.
notes: Gains charges for spells cast by visible enemies in 1200 range.
Certain abilities and item abilities will not add charges.

zh.name: 魔棒
zh.desc:
主动：充能
立刻根据能量点数回复相应的生命和魔法，每点能量恢复15点生命和魔法。

每当附近1200范围内有可见敌人施放技能都会自动充能（最多10点能量）。
notes: 1200范围内的可见敌人使用技能后就会获得点数。
部分英雄技能和物品技能的施放将不会增加点数。

en.name: Magic Wand
en.desc:
Active: Energy Charge
Instantly restores 15 health and mana per charge stored. 

Max 20 charges. Gains a charge whenever a visible enemy within 1200 range uses an ability.
notes: Gains charges for spells cast by visible enemies in 1200 range.
Certain abilities and item abilities will not add charges.

zh.name: 魔杖
zh.desc:
主动：充能
立刻根据能量点数回复相应的生命和魔法，每点能量恢复15点生命和魔法。

每当附近1200范围内有可见敌人施放技能都会自动充能（最多20点能量）。
notes: 1200范围内的可见敌人使用技能后就会获得点数。
部分英雄技能和物品技能的施放将不会增加点数。

en.name: Magnifying Monocle
en.desc:
Passive: Keen Eye
 Increases cast range by 100 and attack range by 100 (Melee & Ranged). Taking over 25 damage from a player controlled source or Roshan disables this effect for 6 seconds.

zh.name: 放大单片镜
zh.desc:
被动：锐利目光
施法距离提升100，攻击距离提升100（近战/远程）。受到来自玩家控制单位或肉山的伤害超过25点会使该效果在6秒内无效。

en.name: Mana Draught
en.desc:
Active: Bottoms Up
Restores 70 + 3% of the caster's maximum mana over 6 seconds. If the hero is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.

Hold Control to use on an allied hero.

Passive: Fill Up
Cooldown Speed of Mana Draught is increased by 30% while in water.

zh.name: 魔力药水
zh.desc:
主动：一饮而尽
在6秒内回复70点魔法 + 3%施法者最大魔法值。承受来自敌方英雄或肉山的伤害会使效果提前结束。

按住Ctrl键可以对友方英雄使用。

被动：填补
站立在水里时魔力药水的冷却速度增加30%。

en.name: Mango Tree
en.desc:
Use: Plant a Mango Tree
 Targets the ground to plant a mango tree that provides unlimited mango power. The tree generates Enchanted Mangoes every 60 seconds, and provides unobstructed vision in the area .

zh.name: 芒果树
zh.desc:
使用：种芒果树
以地面为目标，种下一棵芒果树，可以提供无限的芒果之力。果树每60秒产生一颗魔法芒果，并在区域内提供顺畅视野。

en.name: Manta Style
en.desc:
Active: Mirror Image
Creates 2 images of your hero that last 18 seconds. 

Melee images deal 33% damage, while Ranged images deal 25%. Illusions take 300% damage. 

Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
notes: Has a 0.1 second cast time during which you are invulnerable.
Many effects are removed upon using Manta.
Yasha based movement speed bonuses from multiple items do not stack.

zh.name: 幻影斧
zh.desc:
主动：镜像
制造2个你的幻象，持续18秒。

近战英雄的幻象继承33%的攻击力，远程英雄的幻象继承25%的攻击力。幻象承受300%的伤害。

驱散类型：弱驱散
notes: 有0.1秒的施法时间，其间处于无敌状态。
可以使用幻影斧移除多种负面效果。
不会与其他夜叉、散夜对剑以及幻影斧提供的移动速度加成叠加。

en.name: Martyr's Plate
en.desc:
Active: Martyrdom
 Redirect 25% of all magic damage dealt to your allied heroes within 900 radius towards you for 10 seconds.
notes: Damage done by this item is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

zh.name: 烈士鳞甲
zh.desc:
主动：殉道
将900范围内友方英雄所受魔法伤害的25%转嫁到自己身上，持续10秒。
notes: 这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

en.name: Mask of Madness
en.desc:
Active: Berserk
Gives 100 attack speed, 6% / 12% movement speed (ranged/melee), and 15%/30% slow resistance (ranged/melee), but reduces your armor by 7 and silences you.  Lasts 6 seconds.

Passive: Lifesteal
Heals the attacker for a percentage of physical damage dealt.

zh.name: 疯狂面具
zh.desc:
主动：狂热
攻击速度提升100，移动速度提升6%/12%（远程/近战），减速抗性提升15%/30%（远程/近战），但是护甲降低7点，并且被沉默。持续6秒。

被动：吸血
攻击者每次攻击都将根据造成伤害的一定百分比回复生命值。

en.name: Medallion of Courage
en.desc:
Active: Valor
Increases armor by 7 or decreases armor by -4 for 8s depending on if cast on an ally or enemy. Cannot be cast on self.

zh.name: 勇气勋章
zh.desc:
主动：无畏
根据施放目标为友军或敌人，提升/降低目标7/-4点护甲，持续8秒。无法对自身施放。

en.name: Mekansm
en.desc:
Active: Restore
Restores 250 health to allied units in a 1200 radius.

Passive: Mekansm Aura
Grants 2.5 health regeneration to allied units in a 1200 radius.
notes: Restore does not affect units that have been affected by Restore or Guardian Greaves Mend within Mekansm's cooldown.
Multiple instances of Mekansm Aura do not stack.

zh.name: 梅肯斯姆
zh.desc:
主动：回复
为1200范围内友方单位回复250点生命值。

被动：梅肯斯姆光环
提升1200范围内友方单位2.5点/秒生命恢复。
notes: 梅肯斯姆的冷却时间内回复不能作用于已经被回复或卫士胫甲的修复作用过的单位。
多个梅肯斯姆光环效果不会叠加。

en.name: Metamorphic Mandible
en.desc:
Active: Pupate
 Enter into an insect form for 5 seconds, increasing magic resistance by 50% and movement speed by 20%. While an insect, your size is decreased and your armor is reduced by 45%.

zh.name: 变态上颚
zh.desc:
主动：化蛹
进入昆虫形态，持续5秒，魔法抗性提升50%，移动速度提升20%。在昆虫形态下模型大小减少，护甲减少45%。

en.name: Meteor Hammer
en.desc:
Active: Meteor Hammer
 CHANNELED - After a successful channel, summons a meteor that strikes a 400 AoE, stunning enemies for 0.75 seconds and dealing impact damage. Continues to deal damage over time to enemies units and buildings for 6 seconds. Non-building units are also slowed for 20% for the duration of the burn. 

Building Impact Damage: 90 
Building Over Time Damage: 50 

Non-Building Impact Damage: 130 
Non-Building Over Time Damage: 50 

Channel Duration: 2 seconds.
Landing Time: 0.5 seconds.

zh.name: 陨星锤
zh.desc:
主动：陨星锤
 持续施法 - 成功施法后召唤一颗陨石，打击400范围内敌人，造成0.75秒眩晕和冲击伤害。对敌方单位和建筑造成持续伤害，持续6秒。非建筑单位在烧灼期间还会被减速20%。

对建筑冲击伤害：90
对建筑持续伤害：50

对非建筑冲击伤害：130
对非建筑持续伤害：50

持续施法时间：2秒
落地时间：0.5秒

en.name: Mind Breaker
en.desc:
Passive: Silence Strike
 The next attack silences the hit enemy for 1.5 seconds.

zh.name: 智灭
zh.desc:
被动：沉默打击
下次攻击将沉默敌人，持续1.5秒。

en.name: Minotaur Horn
en.desc:
Active: Lesser Avatar
Applies a basic dispel. Grants 60% magic resistance and immunity to reflected and pure damage for 2s. For the duration of the effect, any negative effect from enemy spells has no effect.

Dispel Type: Basic Dispel

zh.name: 恶牛角
zh.desc:
主动：天仙下凡
施加弱驱散。提供60%魔法抗性加成，并且免疫反弹和纯粹伤害，持续2秒。持续时间内敌方技能的负面效果不会生效。

驱散类型：弱驱散

en.name: Mirror Shield
en.desc:
Passive: Echo Shield
 Block and reflect most targeted spells back to their caster once every 12 seconds.

zh.name: 神镜盾
zh.desc:
被动：回音坚盾
每12秒抵挡并反弹大多数指向性技能给施法者。

en.name: Brigand's Blade
en.desc:
Passive: Dark Mercy
Your attacks deal 3 more damage to enemies for each 7% HP they are missing.

zh.name: 飞贼之刃
zh.desc:
被动：暗黑之仁
敌人每损失7%生命值，对其发动攻击就会额外造成3点伤害。

en.name: Mjollnir
en.desc:
Active: Static Charge
Places a charged shield on a target unit for 12 seconds which has a 20% chance to release a 225 magical damage shocking bolt at a nearby attacker and 4 additional enemies.

Passive: Chain Lightning
Grants a 25% chance on attack to release a bolt of electricity that leaps between 12 targets within a 650 radius, dealing 180 magical damage to each. Lightning proc pierces evasion.
notes: Static Charge cannot trigger more than once per second.
Static Charge's shock deals magical damage centered on hero with the Static Charge. Static Charge's targets cannot be more than 900 range away.
Static Charge procs will not bounce to heroes that are invisible or hidden by Fog of War.

zh.name: 雷神之锤
zh.desc:
主动：静电冲击
对目标单位施加一个静电护盾，持续12秒。护盾有20%几率对附近攻击护盾的目标及其周围4个敌方单位释放闪电冲击，造成225点魔法伤害。

被动：连环闪电
攻击有25%几率释放一道连环闪电，在650范围内12个目标之间跳跃，每次造成180点魔法伤害。触发闪电时无视闪避。
notes: 静电冲击的触发间隔大于1秒。
静电冲击的闪电伤害范围以拥有甲盾的英雄为圆心。静电冲击只会对900范围以内的目标发出闪电冲击。
静电冲击不会弹跳至处于隐身状态下或战争迷雾内的英雄。

en.name: Monkey King Bar
en.desc:
Passive: Pierce
Grants each attack a 80% chance to pierce through evasion and deal 70 bonus magical damage.

zh.name: 金箍棒
zh.desc:
被动：穿刺
每次攻击均有80%几率无视闪避，并造成额外70点魔法伤害。

en.name: Moon Shard
en.desc:
Use: Consume
 Consume the Moon Shard to permanently gain 60 attack speed and 200 bonus night vision. Max 1 use.

Passive: Shade Sight
Grants bonus night vision.

zh.name: 银月之晶
zh.desc:
使用：吞噬
 吞噬银月之晶，永久获得60攻击速度和200夜间视野加成。最多使用1次。

被动：月夜之视
提供额外夜间视野。

en.name: Mercy & Grace
en.desc:
Active: Dead Shot
Fires a ghostly bullet at an enemy unit or tree. When the bullet strikes it will deal 300 damage and slow the target by -100% for 0.5 seconds, then ricochet in the vector-targeted direction. The ricochet will damage all units that it passes through, stopping when it hits a hero. Heroes hit by the ricochet will be feared for 2 seconds in the direction of the shot.
notes: Feared enemies are phased and unslowable.
The ricochet will travel 1x Dead Shot's cast range.

zh.name: 仁慈与恩泽
zh.desc:
主动：弹无虚发
向一个敌方单位或一棵树发射一颗幽灵子弹。子弹击中时将会造成300点伤害并减缓目标-100%移动速度，持续0.5秒，然后沿矢量目标的方向弹去。跳弹将会对穿过的所有单位造成伤害，击中英雄后停下。被跳弹击中的英雄会被恐惧，朝射击方向狂奔2秒。
notes: 被恐惧的敌人为相位状态，无法被减速。
跳弹的行进距离为弹无虚发施法距离的1倍。

en.name: Necronomicon
en.desc:
Active: Demonic Summoning
Summons a Warrior and an Archer to fight for you for 60 seconds.

Warrior:
Burns mana every hit, and deals magical damage to whoever kills it.  Gains True Sight at level 3.
Health: 800 / 1200 / 1600
Damage: 25 / 45 / 65
Mana Break Damage: 30 / 40 / 50
Last Will Damage: 600 / 700 / 800

Archer:
Has a passive movement and attack speed aura. Gains Purge at Level 3.
Health: 800 / 1200 / 1600
Damage: 37 / 57 / 75
Aura Move Speed: 5 / 7 / 9
Aura Radius: 1200

zh.name: 死灵书
zh.desc:
主动：召唤死灵
召唤一个死灵战士和死灵射手为你作战，持续60秒。

战士：
每次攻击燃烧魔法，并且对将其击杀的单位造成魔法伤害。3级时获得真实视域。
生命值：800 / 1200 / 1600
攻击力：25 / 45 / 65
法力损毁伤害：30 / 40 / 50
遗愿伤害：600 / 700 / 800

en.name: Nemesis Curse
en.desc:
Passive: Glass Cannon
 Hero takes 6% more damage from all sources.
Passive: Glassify
 When attacking a hero, apply a debuff increasing the damage received by that hero by 12% for 5 seconds. Only one target can be affected by Glassify at the same time.

zh.name: 天诛之咒
zh.desc:
被动：玻璃大炮
英雄受到的所有来源伤害均增加6%。
被动：玻璃化
攻击英雄时会施加负面效果，使他们承受的所有伤害增加12%，持续5秒。同一时间只有一个敌人会受到玻璃化的作用。

en.name: Ninja Gear
en.desc:
Active: Solitary Disguise
 Casts Smoke of Deceit on yourself only that lasts for up to 15 seconds.

zh.name: 忍者用具
zh.desc:
主动：单独伪装
只对自己施放诡计之雾，持续15秒。

en.name: Nullifier
en.desc:
Active: Nullify
 Dispels the target and applies a debuff for 4 seconds. Continuously dispels and slows the target.

Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
notes: Can be cast on invulnerable units.

zh.name: 否决坠饰
zh.desc:
主动：否决
驱散目标身上的效果，并且施加负面效果，持续4秒。期间持续驱散和减速目标。

驱散类型：弱驱散
notes: 可以对无敌单位施放。

en.name: Occult Bracelet
en.desc:
Passive: Rites of Eloshar
Each time the wearer is attacked, they gain a stack of 0.4 mana regen, up to 5 stacks. Stacks last for 5 seconds.

zh.name: 玄奥手镯
zh.desc:
被动：埃罗莎仪式
每次佩戴者被攻击时都会获得一个0.4点/秒魔法恢复的叠加效果，最多叠加5次。每个叠加效果持续5秒。

en.name: Ocean Heart
en.desc:
Passive: Water Regen
 Provides you with 10 HP regen and 5 mana regen while in the river.

zh.name: 海洋之心
zh.desc:
被动：水中恢复
在河道里提供10点/秒生命恢复和5点/秒魔法恢复。

en.name: Beloved Memory
en.desc:
Active: Honor the Dead
Place this Offering on an Altar to honor the dead with a memory from those they left behind.

zh.name: 挚爱回忆
zh.desc:
主动：纪念死者
把这个祭品放到祭坛上，获得生者的回忆来向死者致敬。

en.name: Forebearer's Fortune
en.desc:
Active: Undying Promise
Signal to the spirits of the other realm your commitment to honoring them. If everyone in the battle makes an Undying Promise before the fight begins, the dead might be willing to listen.

zh.name: 先祖的财富
zh.desc:
主动：永世诺言
通知其他世界的灵魂，承诺会悼念他们。如果战斗中所有人都在比赛开始前做出永世诺言，往生者也许会愿意聆听。

en.name: Scrying Shovel
en.desc:
Active: Dig
Search the map for Offerings to the dead.

zh.name: 占卜之铲
zh.desc:
主动：挖掘
搜索地图去寻找给死者的祭品。

en.name: Ogre Seal Totem
en.desc:
Active: Ogre Seal Flop
 Flop forward like an ogre seal 2 times, dealing 250 damage and slowing enemies in a 275 radius by -100% for 1.5 second on each bounce. 400 bounce distance.

zh.name: 食人魔海豹图腾
zh.desc:
主动：食人魔海豹扑打
像食人魔海豹一样向前扑打2次，每次扑打对275范围内敌人造成250点伤害和持续1.5秒的-100%减速。400扑跳距离。

en.name: Orb of Corrosion
en.desc:
Passive: Corrosion
 Your attacks reduce the target's armor by -2, slows their movement by -16% (-8% against melee targets), and reduces Health Restoration by 18%. Lasts for 3 seconds.
notes: Armor reduction does not stack with its components, Desolator, or Stygian Desolator.

zh.name: 腐蚀之珠
zh.desc:
被动：腐蚀
攻击会使目标的护甲减少-2点，远程目标会被减速-16%，近战目标会被减速-8%。生命回复减少18%，持续3秒。
notes: 护甲降低效果不会与其配件，黯灭或寂灭叠加。

en.name: Orb of Destruction
en.desc:
Passive: Impeding Corruption
 Attacks reduce the target's armor and movement speed. Slow amount varies based on whether the wearer is melee or ranged.

zh.name: 毁灭灵球
zh.desc:
被动：腐蚀阻碍
攻击会降低目标的护甲和移动速度。减速数值根据携带者为近战或远程而有不同。

en.name: Orb of Frost
en.desc:
Passive: Frost
Your attacks slow the target's movement by -13% (-6% against melee targets), and reduces Health Restoration by 15%. Lasts for 3 seconds.

zh.name: 冰霜之珠
zh.desc:
被动：冰霜
攻击使远程目标被减速-13%，近战目标被减速-6%。生命回复减少15%。持续3秒。

en.name: Orb of Venom
en.desc:
Passive: Poison Attack
Poisons the target, dealing 12 magical damage per second. Lasts for 3 seconds.
notes: Does not stack with its upgrades.

zh.name: 淬毒之珠
zh.desc:
被动：毒性攻击
使目标中毒，造成每秒12点魔法伤害。持续3秒。
notes: 不与后续升级物品叠加。

en.name: Orchid Malevolence
en.desc:
Active: Soul Burn
Silences the target unit for 5 seconds. At the end of the silence, 30% of the damage received while silenced is inflicted as bonus magical damage.

zh.name: 紫怨
zh.desc:
主动：灵魂燃烧
沉默目标单位5秒，沉默结束后所受伤害的30%将以额外魔法伤害的形式结算。

en.name: Outworld Staff
en.desc:
Active: Self-Exile
 Makes the caster completely invulnerable and disabled for 0.7 seconds. When returning to the world, the caster takes 5% of their maximum health as damage.
notes: Damage taken when returning is non-lethal and disables Blink Dagger and other items that are muted upon taking damage.

zh.name: 殁境法杖
zh.desc:
主动：自我放逐
使施法者无敌且被控制，持续0.7秒。施法者回归时会受到5%最大生命值的伤害。
notes: 承受的回归伤害不会致死，会禁用闪烁匕首和其他受到伤害时会被锁闭的物品。

en.name: Overwhelming Blink
en.desc:
Active: Overwhelming Blink
 Teleport to a target point up to 1200 units away.

After teleportation, all enemies in a 800 AoE take damage equal to 100 + 50% of your strength and an additional 100% over time, and have 50% movement speed slow and 50 attack speed slow for 6 seconds. 

Overwhelming Blink cannot be used for 3 seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
notes: Self-casting will cause you to teleport in the direction of your team's fountain.

zh.name: 盛势闪光
zh.desc:
主动：盛势闪光
传送到最远1200距离的位置。

传送后，800范围内所有敌人受到100 + 50%力量值的瞬时伤害，并且额外持续受到总计为100%力量值的伤害，被减缓50%移动速度，降低50攻击速度，持续6秒。

受到来自敌方英雄或肉山的攻击时，盛势闪光将在3秒内无法使用。
notes: 快速点击两次会将自己往己方泉水方向传送。

en.name: Fae Grenade
en.desc:
Active: Shadow Brand
Throws a Mark towards an enemy within 900 range applying a debuff that deals 40 damage every second and provides vision of the unit for 7 seconds.
notes: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

zh.name: 仙灵榴弹
zh.desc:
主动：暗影烙印
向900范围内一个敌人投掷一个面具，施加一个负面效果，造成每秒40点伤害，并获得该单位的视野，持续7秒。
notes: 不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

en.name: Magic Lamp
en.desc:
Passive: Rejuvenate
 When the wearer's health falls below 20%, they will receive a strong dispel and be healed for 1500 health.

Dispel Type: Strong Dispel

zh.name: 神妙明灯
zh.desc:
被动：回春
佩戴者的生命值低于20%时将被施加强驱散，并且被治疗1500点生命。

驱散类型：强驱散

en.name: Partisan's Brand
en.desc:
Passive: Brand
 Increases spell damage dealt to player controlled targets by 9%.
notes: Player controlled targets includes heroes and any creep summoned or converted by them.

zh.name: 天游烙印
zh.desc:
被动：烙印
对玩家控制目标造成的技能伤害提升9%。
notes: 玩家控制目标包括英雄和他们召唤和劝化的所有非英雄单位。

en.name: Pavise
en.desc:
Active: Protect
 When cast on an ally, grants them a physical damage barrier that absorbs 250 damage. Duration: 7s.

zh.name: 长盾
zh.desc:
主动：保护
对友军施放后施加可以吸收250点物理伤害的护盾 。持续时间：7秒。

en.name: Penta-Edged Sword
en.desc:
Passive: Maim
Each attack has a 25% chance to reduce enemy hero movement speed by 20% and attack speed by 60 for 3 seconds.

zh.name: 五锋长剑
zh.desc:
被动：残废
每次攻击有25%几率减缓敌方英雄20%移动速度，60攻击速度，持续3秒。

en.name: Phase Boots
en.desc:
Active: Phase
 Gives 20% increased movement speed on melee heroes, and 10% on ranged heroes, and lets you move through units and turn more quickly for 3 seconds.
Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.

zh.name: 相位鞋
zh.desc:
主动：相位移动
提升移动速度并使你可以穿越单位，转身也更快，持续3秒。近战英雄提升20%移动速度，远程英雄提升10%移动速度。
多个鞋类物品提供的移动速度加成不叠加。

en.name: Phoenix Ash
en.desc:
Passive: Rebirth
Lethal damage is prevented and instead the wearer is healed to half health and non-ultimate ability cooldowns reset. Gets consumed on trigger.

zh.name: 凤凰余烬
zh.desc:
被动：重生
阻止致命伤害，使携带者的生命值回复到一半，并重置非终极技能的技能冷却。触发后将被消耗。

en.name: Phylactery
en.desc:
Passive: Empower Spell
 The next Unit Target spell you cast on an enemy deals a separate 150 bonus damage to the target and slows them by 30% for 3s.

zh.name: 灵匣
zh.desc:
被动：法术强化
 下个对敌人施放的单体技能会单独对目标造成150点额外伤害，并且减缓30%移动速度，持续3秒。

en.name: Pipe of Insight
en.desc:
Active: Barrier
Gives a magic damage barrier that absorbs 425 damage to all nearby allies. Lasts 8 seconds.

Radius: 1200

Passive: Insight Aura
 Gives allied units 8% magic resistance.

Radius: 1200
notes: Barrier does not affect units that have been affected by Barrier within Pipe of Insight's cooldown.
Stacks multiplicatively with other sources of magic resistance.

zh.name: 洞察烟斗
zh.desc:
主动：魔法护盾
为周围友方单位套上能抵挡425点魔法伤害的护盾 。持续8秒。

作用范围：1200

被动：洞察光环
 提升友方单位8%魔法抗性。

作用范围：1200
notes: 护盾不会作用于洞察烟斗的冷却时间内已受过护盾作用的单位。
能与其他提高魔法抗性的技能叠加。

en.name: Pirate Hat
en.desc:
Passive: Plunder
 Steals 150 gold from enemy heroes that die within 2400 units. If the wearer is the killer, there is no range limit and an additional 400 gold is stolen.
Passive: Buried Treasure
 Gold loss on death reduced by 100%.

zh.name: 海盗帽
zh.desc:
被动：抢劫
从2400范围内阵亡的敌方英雄身上偷取150金。如果海盗帽的佩戴者是击杀者，那么没有距离限制，而且还会额外偷取400金。
被动：藏宝
死亡时损失的金钱减少100%。

en.name: Tumbler's Toy
en.desc:
Active: Vault
Propels your hero forward 300 units. Tumbler's Toy gets disabled for 3 seconds if its owner receives damage from a player source.

zh.name: 杂技玩具
zh.desc:
主动：跳跃
使自身向前推进300距离。拥有者在3秒内受到来自玩家的伤害将无法使用杂技玩具。

en.name: Pollywog Charm
en.desc:
Active: Ribbit
 Increases the health regeneration of a target ally by 8 for 14 seconds. While standing in water, the blessed unit also moves 10% faster.

zh.name: 蝌蚪护符
zh.desc:
主动：呱呱
目标友军的生命恢复提升8点/秒，持续14秒。在水中时，受到福佑的单位还会加速10%。

en.name: Poor Man's Shield
en.desc:
Passive: Damage Block
Gives a 100% chance to block 30 damage from incoming attacks on melee heroes, and 20 damage on ranged.

Has a 50% chance to block damage from creeps.
notes: Multiple sources of damage block do not stack.

zh.name: 穷鬼盾
zh.desc:
被动：伤害格挡
近战英雄有100%几率格挡30点伤害，远程英雄为20点伤害。

有50%几率格挡来自非英雄单位的伤害。
notes: 多种伤害格挡物品的效果互不叠加。

en.name: Possessed Mask
en.desc:
Passive: Lifesteal
Heals the attacker for 5 HP on each attack.
notes: Grants 1/3rd of the value to each attribute for Universal Heroes.

zh.name: 附魂面具
zh.desc:
被动：吸血
攻击者每次攻击都将回复5点生命值。
notes: 对全才英雄提供1/3全属性。

en.name: Power Treads
en.desc:
Active: Switch Attribute
Switches between +10 Strength, +10 Agility, or +10 Intelligence.
Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.
notes: Power Treads can be built using a Belt of Strength, Band of Elvenskin, or a Robe of the Magi.

zh.name: 动力鞋
zh.desc:
主动：属性切换
将附加属性在力量，敏捷以及智力三者间切换，选择+10点力量，+10点敏捷或+10点智力。
多个鞋类物品提供的移动速度加成不叠加。
notes: 动力鞋可以使用力量腰带、精灵布带或法师长袍合成。

en.name: Prince's Knife
en.desc:
Passive: Hex Strike
 The next attack hexes the hit enemy into a frog for 1.5 seconds.

zh.name: 亲王短刀
zh.desc:
被动：妖术打击
下次攻击会将击中的敌人变成青蛙，持续1.5秒。

en.name: Prophet's Pendulum
en.desc:
Passive: Linger
 30% of incoming damage is delayed over 5 seconds.

zh.name: 先知灵摆
zh.desc:
被动：延缓
承受伤害的30%会延迟到5秒内施加。

en.name: Psychic Headband
en.desc:
Active: Psychic Push
Pushes the target unit away from you 400 distance.
notes: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

zh.name: 通灵头带
zh.desc:
主动：通灵推行
将目标单位向自己推远400距离。
notes: 不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

en.name: Pupil's Gift
en.desc: Increases both non-primary attributes.
notes: Grants two-thirds value to each attribute for Universal Heroes

zh.name: 学徒之礼
zh.desc: 提升了两种非主属性。
notes: 对全才英雄提供2/3的全属性

en.name: Pyrrhic Cloak
en.desc:
Active: Retribution
 For the next 6 seconds, 75% of damage taken by the caster is reflected to the target unit as physical damage if they are within 1200 units away.
notes: Damage done by this item is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

zh.name: 皮洛士斗篷
zh.desc:
主动：报应
在接下来6秒内施法者所受伤害的75%会作为物理伤害反弹至目标单位，只要他们还在1200距离内。
notes: 这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

en.name: Quelling Blade
en.desc:
Active: Chop Tree
 Destroy a target tree.  

Passive: Quell
 Increases attack damage against non-hero units by 8 for melee heroes, and 4 for ranged.
notes: Effects of multiple quelling blades do not stack.

zh.name: 压制之刃
zh.desc:
主动：砍伐
 砍伐一根指定树木。

被动：压制
对非英雄单位进行物理攻击会造成额外伤害，近战英雄为8点，远程英雄为4点。
notes: 多个压制之刃效果不会叠加。

en.name: Quickening Charm
en.desc:
Passive: Cooldown Reduction
Reduces the cooldown time of all spells and items.

zh.name: 加速护符
zh.desc:
被动：冷却时间减少
降低所有技能和物品的冷却时间。

en.name: Quicksilver Amulet
en.desc:
Passive: Quicksilver
Grants you a bonus 5% movement speed and 20 attack speed anytime one of your abilities are on cooldown.

zh.name: 银闪护符
zh.desc:
被动：银闪
有技能在冷却状态中时额外获得5%移动速度加成和20攻击速度加成。

en.name: Radiance
en.desc:
Toggle: Burn
 When active, scorches enemies for 60 magical damage per second. Illusions deal 35 magical damage per second.

Radius: 650

zh.name: 辉耀
zh.desc:
开关：辉耀灼烧
开启后，辉耀灼烧每秒对敌军造成60点魔法伤害。幻象每秒造成35点魔法伤害。

作用范围：650

en.name: Divine Rapier
en.desc:
Toggle: Transmute
 Toggle to gain either 25% bonus spell amplification or 250 bonus attack damage.

Passive: Everlasting
 Dropped on death, and cannot be destroyed. 

Becomes unusable if picked up by an ally of its owner until it is returned to its owner. It is immediately usable by anybody if an enemy of the owner picks it up and is killed. A dropped Rapier cannot be picked up by a courier.
notes: If Divine Rapier is dropped and picked up by an enemy of its original owner, it cannot be dropped again except by death.
Spell Amplification from multiple Rapiers does not stack.

zh.name: 圣剑
zh.desc:
切换：转变
在25%技能增强加成和250攻击力加成之间切换。

被动：永恒
 死亡后掉落，而且无法被摧毁。

当拥有者的队友拾取后，仅在返还给拥有者后才会有效。一旦被敌人拾取，圣剑将不再受此限制，信使无法拾取掉落的圣剑。
notes: 如果圣剑掉落后被拥有者的敌人拾取，那么只有在敌人死亡后才会再次掉落。
多个圣剑的技能增强不会叠加。

en.name: Rattlecage
en.desc:
Passive: Reverberate
 After taking 220 damage from any source, the wearer fires a projectile at up to 2 random enemies in a 600 radius, prioritizing heroes, that deal 90 physical damage and slow the targets movement and attack speed by 100% for 0.2s.
notes: Damage done by this item is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

zh.name: 回响之笼
zh.desc:
被动：回荡
受到任意来源的220点伤害后，佩戴者对附近600范围内最多2个随机敌人发射一个弹道，以英雄优先，造成90点物理伤害并降低目标100%移动和攻击速度，持续0.2秒。
notes: 这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

zh.name: 图纸（莫尔迪基安的臂章）
图纸（弗拉迪米尔的祭品）

en.name: Refresher Orb
en.desc:
Active: Reset Cooldowns
Resets the cooldowns of all your abilities. Shares a cooldown with Refresher Shard. This item's cooldown only progresses in your hero's main inventory.
en.shard:
Use: Reset Cooldowns
Resets the cooldowns of all your abilities. Shares a cooldown with Refresher Orb. This item's cooldown only progresses in your hero's main inventory.

zh.name: 刷新球
zh.desc:
主动：完全重置
重置所有技能的冷却时间。与刷新球碎片共享冷却时间。这件物品只会在英雄的主物品栏中进行冷却。
zh.shard:
主动：完全重置
重置所有技能的冷却时间。与刷新球共享冷却时间。这件物品只会在英雄的主物品栏中进行冷却。

en.name: Refresher Shard
en.desc:
Use: Reset Cooldowns
Resets the cooldowns of all your abilities. Shares a cooldown with Refresher Orb. This item's cooldown only progresses in your hero's main inventory.
notes: Refresher Shard is shareable.

zh.name: 刷新球碎片
zh.desc:
主动：完全重置
重置所有技能的冷却时间。与刷新球共享冷却时间。这件物品只会在英雄的主物品栏中进行冷却。
notes: 刷新球碎片可以共享。

en.name: Repair Kit
en.desc:
Use: Building Repair
 Targets a building, restoring 40% of it's health over 30 seconds. Also grants +10 armor during this period.

zh.name: 维修器具
zh.desc:
使用：修复建筑
以建筑为目标，在30秒内回复40%生命值。另外在此期间提供+10点护甲。

en.name: Revenant's Brooch
en.desc:
Passive: Phantom Critical
Grants each attack a 30% chance to deal an additional 80% of the attack's damage as bonus magic damage.
notes: Counts as a Critical Strike for purposes of stacking with other sources of Critical Strike.
Phantom Critical does not work against buildings.

zh.name: 英灵胸针
zh.desc:
被动：幻影暴击
每次攻击都有30%几率造成额外的魔法伤害，数值为攻击伤害的80%。
notes: 对于其他来源的致命一击也被视为致命一击效果。
攻击建筑物时不会触发幻影暴击。

en.name: Riftshadow Prism
en.desc:
Active: Refract
 Spend 8% of your current life total to create a full health illusion that lasts for 20 seconds. The illusion has 60% outgoing damage and takes 200% of incoming damage.

zh.name: 影墟棱晶
zh.desc:
主动：折射
消耗自身8%当前生命值，制造一个满血的幻象，持续20秒。幻象造成60%伤害，承受200%伤害。

en.name: Ring of Aquila
en.desc:
Passive: Aquila Aura
Grants 1 mana regeneration and 2 armor to nearby allies.

Radius: 1200
Toggle: Aura
 Deactivate to stop affecting non-hero units.
notes: Multiple instances of Aquila Aura do not stack.

zh.name: 天鹰之戒
zh.desc:
被动：天鹰光环
给予周围友军额外1点/秒魔法恢复和2点护甲。

作用范围：1200
开关：光环
 关闭后不会作用于非英雄单位。
notes: 多个天鹰光环效果不会叠加。

en.name: Ring of Basilius
en.desc:
Passive: Basilius Aura
Grants 1 mana regeneration to allies.  

Radius: 1200

zh.name: 王者之戒
zh.desc:
被动：王者光环
提升友方单位1点/秒魔法恢复。

作用范围：1200

en.name: Ripper's Lash
en.desc:
Active: Flay
Embeds thorns into all enemies in a 200 unit radius. Affected units take additional damage when attacked for 10 seconds.

zh.name: 撕裂之鞭
zh.desc:
主动：剥皮
把荆棘刺入200范围内所有敌人。在10秒内，他们被攻击时都会承受额外伤害。

en.name: Rod of Atos
en.desc:
Active: Cripple
Roots the target for 2 seconds.

zh.name: 阿托斯之棍
zh.desc:
主动：致残
缠绕目标，持续2秒。

en.name: Roshan's Banner
en.desc:
Use: Place Banner
 Creates a banner at the target location. Lane creeps in the area of effect become damage immune while the Banner is up. Lasts 120 seconds.

 Can be destroyed. Melee hero attacks deal 2x damage to the banner.

zh.name: 肉山的战旗
zh.desc:
使用：放置战旗
在目标地点创造一面旗帜。战旗立起后作用范围内的小兵将免疫伤害。战旗持续120秒。

可以被摧毁。近战英雄对战旗造成2倍伤害。

en.name: Royal Jelly
en.desc:
Active: Consume
 Consumes all charges and grants a target allied unit a buff that provides +2.5 Health Regen and +1.25 Mana Regen per charge for 8s. 

If the unit is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.

zh.name: 蜂王浆
zh.desc:
主动：服食
消耗蜂王浆的所有能量点数并向一个目标友方单位提供一个状态效果，每点点数提供+2.5 生命恢复和+1.25 魔法恢复，持续8秒。

如果目标受到来自肉山或敌方英雄的伤害则失去效果。

en.name: Block of Cheese
en.desc:
Use: Scrumptious
Try me!

zh.name: 奶酪块
zh.desc:
使用：可口
倒是吃啊！

en.name: Safety Bubble
en.desc:
Passive: Bubbled Up
 Equipped Hero has a 100 HP Barrier against enemy damage. Barrier fully regenerates after not receiving damage for 8 seconds. Self-inflicted damage bypasses the barrier.

zh.name: 安全泡泡
zh.desc:
被动：冒泡
装备的英雄拥有一个可吸收敌方伤害的100点生命的护盾。 8秒内没有受到伤害后，护盾将恢复至满血。护盾不会吸收自残伤害。

en.name: Sange and Yasha
notes: Yasha-based movement speed bonuses from multiple items do not stack.

zh.name: 散夜对剑
notes: 不会与其他夜叉、散夜对剑以及幻影斧提供的移动速度加成叠加。

en.name: Satanic
en.desc:
Active: Unholy Rage
Increases Lifesteal percentage to 175% for 6 seconds. 

Dispel Type: Basic Dispel 

Passive: Lifesteal
Heals the attacker for a percentage of physical damage dealt.

zh.name: 撒旦之邪力
zh.desc:
主动：不洁狂热
吸血效果提升至175%，持续6秒。

驱散类型：弱驱散

被动：吸血
攻击者每次攻击都将根据造成伤害的一定百分比回复生命值。

en.name: Searing Signet
en.desc:
Passive: Burn Through
 Instances of magic damage from spells over 60 ignites enemies, causing them to take 80 magic damage over 6 seconds. Burn damage against non-hero targets is decreased by 50%.
notes: Will not ignite enemies that are more than 2000 range away.

zh.name: 炽热纹章
zh.desc:
被动：烧蚀
单次魔法伤害超过60点会使敌人着火，使他们在6秒内受到80点魔法伤害。对非英雄目标的烧蚀伤害减少50%。
notes: 不会点燃2000距离以外的敌人。

en.name: Seeds of Serenity
en.desc:
Active: Verdurous Dale
  Target the ground with a 400 radius. Provides health regeneration to all allied units while they are in the area of effect equal to 8 + 25% of the caster's health regeneration at the time of casting. Lasts 8 seconds.

zh.name: 宁静种籽
zh.desc:
主动：盎然生机
对400范围的地面施放。对作用范围内所有友方单位提供+8点/秒生命恢复 + 25%施法者施法时生命恢复。持续8秒。

en.name: Seer Stone
en.desc:
Active: Reveal
 Reveal a target 800 area of the map for 6 seconds.

zh.name: 先哲之石
zh.desc:
主动：揭示
揭示地图上800范围的区域，持续6秒。

en.name: Serrated Shiv
en.desc:
Passive: Gut 'Em
 Attacks have a 20% chance to have True Strike and deal 8% of the target's current health as bonus physical damage. Deals a flat bonus of 200 against Roshan.

zh.name: 锯齿短刀
zh.desc:
被动：悍劲
攻击拥有20%几率触发克敌机先，并且造成额外物理伤害，数值为8%目标当前生命值。攻击对肉山触发时总是造成固定200点额外伤害。

en.name: Shadow Amulet
en.desc:
Active: Fade
Grants invisibility to you or a target allied hero for 3.5s. Movement speed during the invisibility is reduced by 35%.
notes: Takes 1.25s of the 3.5s for the hero to fully fade into invisibility.

zh.name: 暗影护符
zh.desc:
主动：渐隐
使自身或友方英雄目标获得隐身效果，持续3.5秒。隐身期间的移动速度减缓35%。
notes: 需要3.5秒中的1.25秒才能使英雄完全进入隐身状态。

en.name: Shawl
notes: Stacks multiplicatively with other sources of magic resistance.

zh.name: 披巾
notes: 能与其他提高魔法抗性的技能叠加。

en.name: Scythe of Vyse
en.desc:
Active: Hex
Turns a target unit into a harmless critter for 2.8 seconds. The target has a base movement speed of 140 and will be silenced, muted, and disarmed.
Instantly destroys illusions.
notes: The target will have a base movement speed of 140, but buffs granting maximum movement speed won't be disabled.

zh.name: 邪恶镰刀
zh.desc:
主动：妖术
将一个单位变成无害的小动物，持续2.8秒。目标的基础移速变为140，并且被沉默、锁闭和缴械。
幻象会被立刻消灭。
notes: 目标的基础移速将降至140，但是若拥有极限移动速度的状态就不会受影响。

en.name: Shiva's Guard
en.desc:
Active: Arctic Blast
 Emits a freezing wave that deals 225 magical damage to enemies and slows their movement by -40% for 4 seconds.

Radius: 825

Passive: Freezing Aura
 Reduces the attack speed of all enemies by -40. 

Radius: 1200
notes: The wave extends at a speed of 400 to a max size of 825.
The Arctic Blast follows its caster.
Multiple instances of Freezing Aura do not stack.
AoE bonuses from multiple Chasm Stones or its upgrades do not stack.

zh.name: 希瓦的守护
zh.desc:
主动：极寒冲击
发出一道寒冷的波动，对敌人造成225点魔法伤害并减速-40%，持续4秒。

作用范围：825

被动：霜冷光环
降低所有敌人-40攻击速度。

作用范围：1200
notes: 极寒冲击的扩张速度为400，最大半径为825。
极寒冲击将以施放者为中心。
多个霜冷光环效果不会叠加。
多个裂隙之石或升级物品的作用范围加成不会叠加。

en.name: Silver Edge
en.desc:
Active: Shadow Walk
Makes you invisible for 17 seconds, or until you attack or cast a spell.  While invisible, you move 20% faster and can move through units.  

Attacking to end the invisibility will deal 300 bonus physical damage, disable their passive abilities for 5 seconds, and cap their movement speed to 200.

zh.name: 白银之锋
zh.desc:
主动：疾影步
进入隐身直到17秒持续时间结束、或者在此之前攻击或施法。隐身时，移动速度将提升20%，而且可以穿越单位。

破隐一击将额外造成300点物理伤害，同时5秒内目标的被动技能无效，移动速度不会超过200。

en.name: Sister's Shroud
en.desc:
Passive: Veiled
When falling below 50% HP, gain 150% evasion for 5 seconds. While active, dodging an attack decreases the evasion bonus by 75% of its current value.
Passive: Last Caress
Veiled cooldown is only reset if the wearer dies or kills an enemy hero.
notes: Does not trigger from damage by non-player controlled creeps

zh.name: 魅影之衣
zh.desc:
被动：蒙纱
每当生命值低于50%就会获得150% 闪避加成，持续5秒。每次成功闪避攻击后这个闪避效果就会减少当前数值的75%。
被动：临终关怀
蒙纱的冷却时间只会在佩戴者阵亡或者击杀一名敌方英雄后重置。
notes: 受到来自非玩家控制的非英雄单位的伤害不会触发。

en.name: Eye of Skadi
en.desc:
Passive: Cold Attack
 Attacks lower enemy movement by -25% if they are melee and -50% if they are ranged. Attacks also lower enemy attack speed by -25% and Health Restoration by 50%. Lasts for 3 seconds.

zh.name: 斯嘉蒂之眼
zh.desc:
被动：霜冻攻击
攻击对敌方远程目标会减缓-50%移动速度，对敌方近战目标会减缓-25%移动速度。攻击还会降低敌人-25%攻击速度和50%生命回复。持续3秒。

en.name: Smoke of Deceit
en.desc:
Use: Disguise
 Turns the caster and all allied player-controlled targets in a 1200 radius invisible, and grants 15% bonus movement speed for 45 seconds. 

 While the caster is still disguised, any allies that come within 300 range of them will also get the buff applied to them. Each smoke can only be applied once to allies. 

Attacking or moving within 1025 range of an enemy hero or tower, will break the invisibility. 

Disguise grants invisibility that is immune to True Sight. 

Smoke of Deceit is usable from the backpack and has no cooldown when swapped into the main inventory.

zh.name: 诡计之雾
zh.desc:
使用：潜行
施法者和附近1200范围内的友方玩家控制目标在45秒内获得隐身效果和15%移动速度加成。他们在小地图上的图标也会消失。

只要施法者还在潜行状态下，任意友军进入他身边300范围内也会获得加成效果。每个诡计之雾只能对一名友军施加一次效果。 

发动攻击，或靠近敌方英雄或防御塔1025距离后将打破隐身效果。

潜行的隐身效果不受真实视域影响。

诡计之雾在背包中可以直接使用，换至主物品栏时没有冷却时间。

en.name: Solar Crest
en.desc:
Active: Shine
When cast on an ally, grants them 5 armor, 60 attack speed, 15% movement speed and a 350 physical damage barrier. 

Does not grant bonus armor, movement or attack speed if used on self. 

Duration: 7
notes: Shares cooldown with Pavise.

zh.name: 炎阳纹章
zh.desc:
主动：日耀
对友军施放可以提供5点护甲，60攻击速度，15%移动速度和350点生命的物理伤害护盾。

对自身施放时不会提供护甲、移动速度和攻击速度加成。

持续时间：7
notes: 与长盾共享冷却时间。

en.name: Soul Ring
en.desc:
Active: Sacrifice
 Consume 170 health to temporarily gain 170 mana.  Lasts 10 seconds.

If the mana gained cannot fit in your mana pool, it creates a buffer of mana that will be used before your mana pool.
notes: If this mana is not used before the duration ends, the extra mana is lost.

zh.name: 灵魂之戒
zh.desc:
主动：献身
 消耗170点生命值来暂时获取170点魔法值。持续10秒。

如果获得魔法后超过了自身的魔法上限，多出来的魔法会加入上限，并优先被使用。
notes: 如果在持续时间结束时没有使用，额外的魔法将会消失。

en.name: Spark of Courage
en.desc:
Passive: Courage
 Provides 10 damage when the hero is above 50% Health, and 5 armor when they are below that threshold.

zh.name: 勇气之光
zh.desc:
被动：勇气
 在拥有者血量高于50%时提供10点攻击力，低于该临界值时提供5点护甲。

en.name: Specialist's Array
en.desc:
Passive: Splitshot
Ranged attacks have a 30% chance to fire additional projectiles at up to 2 nearby enemies with 150 extra range and within a 120 degree angle in front of the attacker. The additional projectiles deal 20 + 75% damage of a normal attack and do not trigger on hit effects. The primary attack deals 20 + 100% damage of a normal attack.

zh.name: 行家阵列
zh.desc:
被动：分裂射击
远程攻击有30%的概率向非原攻击目标的前方120度角内、攻击距离+150距离内的最多2个附近敌人发射额外弹道。额外弹道造成20 + 75%普通攻击伤害，并且不会触发击中效果。主攻击造成20 + 100%普通攻击伤害。

en.name: Spell Prism
en.desc:
Passive: Cooldown Reduction
Reduces the cooldown time of all spells and items.

zh.name: 法术棱镜
zh.desc:
被动：冷却时间减少
降低所有技能和物品的冷却时间。

en.name: Spellslinger
en.desc:
Passive: Salvo
20% of the mana used to cast abilities is recovered over 10 seconds.

zh.name: 咏咒之坠
zh.desc:
被动：齐鸣
施放技能使用的20%魔法消耗会在10秒内恢复。

en.name: Linken's Sphere
en.desc:
Passive: Spellblock
Blocks most targeted spells once every 14 seconds.

Active: Transfer Spellblock
Temporarily removes Spellblock from the item's owner and transfers it to an allied unit for 14 seconds.
notes: Targeted abilities from neutral items do not trigger Spellblock.

zh.name: 林肯法球
zh.desc:
被动：法术抵抗
每14秒被动抵挡一次大部分指向性技能。

主动：抵抗转移
将抵挡状态暂时转移给一个友方单位，持续14秒。
notes: 中立物品的指向性技能不会触发法术抵抗。

en.name: Spider Legs
en.desc:
Active: Skitter
 Grants you 20% bonus movement speed, 50% improved turn rate, and free pathing for 12 seconds. Walking over trees causes them to be destroyed.

zh.name: 网虫腿
zh.desc:
主动：急行
提供20%移动速度加成，50%转身速率加成和无视地形的移动，持续12秒。经过树木时会导致树木被摧毁。

en.name: Spirit Vessel
en.desc:
Active: Soul Release
 When used against enemies, it reduces health by 4% of current health per second, and reduces Health Restoration by 70%. Deals 25 damage per second. 

When used on allies, it provides 40 health regeneration per second. 

Lasts 8 seconds.

Gains charges every time an enemy hero dies within 1500 units or the user dies.
notes: Empty vessels gain 2 charges.
Only the closest Spirit Vessel to the dying hero will gain a charge.
If the allied unit is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

zh.name: 魂之灵瓮
zh.desc:
主动：灵魂释放
对敌人使用时，每秒减少4%当前生命值，并且生命回复降低70%。每秒造成25点伤害。

对友军使用时，提供40点/秒生命恢复。

持续8秒。

每当敌方英雄在1500范围内死亡时获得充能。
notes: 点数为0的灵瓮将获得2点能量。
只有距离阵亡英雄最近的魂之灵瓮才会获得一点能量。
如果友方单位被敌方英雄或肉山攻击，效果将会消失。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

en.name: Telescope
en.desc:
Passive: Prescient Aura
 Lowers Scan cooldown by 50% . Increases attack range (Ranged only) and cast range of allies in a 1200 unit radius.

zh.name: 望远镜
zh.desc:
被动：预知光环
扫描的冷却时间减少50%。提升1200范围内友军的攻击距离（仅远程）和施法距离。
stats: 光环的攻击距离加成（仅远程）： 75

en.name: Stonefeather Satchel
en.desc:
Toggle: Transmogrify
 Toggle to switch the contents of the Satchel between a pound of Feathers or Rocks.

Feathers: increase movement speed by 12 and distance of forced movement effects applied to the wearer by 30%.

Rocks: increase armor by 3 and decrease the distance of forced movement effects applied to the wearer by 30%.

zh.name: 石羽小包
zh.desc:
切换：变幻
切换会使小包里的东西在羽毛和石头之间变换。

羽毛：移动速度提升12，施加给佩戴者的强制位移效果提升30%。

石头：提升3点护甲，施加给佩戴者的强制位移效果减少30%。

en.name: Stormcrafter
en.desc:
Passive: Bottled Lightning
 Zaps 2 enemy targets within 700 range, dealing 70 damage and a 40% slow for 0.4 seconds.

zh.name: 风暴宝器
zh.desc:
被动：瓶装闪电
电击700范围内2个敌方单位，造成70点伤害，并减缓40%移动速度，持续0.4秒。

en.name: Stout Shield
en.desc:
Passive: Damage Block
Grants a 50% chance to block 20 damage from incoming attacks on melee heroes, and 8 damage on ranged.
notes: Multiple sources of damage block do not stack.

zh.name: 圆盾
zh.desc:
被动：伤害格挡
拥有50%几率格挡伤害，近战英雄可格挡20点伤害，远程英雄可格挡8点。
notes: 多种伤害格挡物品的效果互不叠加。

en.name: Swift Blink
en.desc:
Active: Swift Blink
 Teleport to a target point up to 1200 units away.

After teleportation, you gain 40% phased movement speed and +35 Agility for 6 seconds. 

Swift Blink cannot be used for 3 seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
notes: Self-casting will cause you to teleport in the direction of your team's fountain.

zh.name: 迅疾闪光
zh.desc:
主动：迅疾闪光
传送到最远1200距离的位置。

传送后获得40%移动速度加成和相位移动状态，+35点敏捷，持续6秒。

受到来自敌方英雄或肉山的攻击时，迅疾闪光将在3秒内无法使用。
notes: 快速点击两次会将自己往己方泉水方向传送。

en.name: Talisman of Evasion
notes: Stacks diminishingly with other sources of Evasion.

zh.name: 闪避护符
notes: 与其他闪避效果为非线性叠加。

en.name: Tango
en.desc:
Use: Devour
 Consumes a target tree to gain 7 health regeneration for 16 seconds. Consuming an Ironwood Tree doubles the heal duration.

Comes with 3 charges.  Can be used on an allied hero to give them one Tango.

Tree Range: 165

zh.name: 树之祭祀
zh.desc:
使用：吞食
吃掉一棵树，获得7点/秒生命恢复，持续16秒。食用铁树枝干种下的小树后恢复时间加倍。

可以使用3次。对友方英雄使用可以分给他一次使用机会。

吞食树木施法距离：165

en.name: Tango (Shared)
en.desc:
Use: Devour
 Consumes a target tree to gain 3.5 health regeneration for 16 seconds. Consuming an Ironwood Tree doubles the heal duration.

Tree Range: 165

zh.name: 树之祭祀（共享）
zh.desc:
使用：吞食
吃掉一棵树，获得3.5点/秒生命恢复，持续16秒。食用铁树枝干种下的小树后恢复时间加倍。

距离：165

en.name: The Leveller
en.desc:
Passive: Level
 Attacks deal 35% more damage to buildings.

zh.name: 平世剑
zh.desc:
被动：平世
攻击对建筑造成的伤害增加35%。

en.name: Third Eye
en.desc:
Passive: True Sight
 Grants the ability to see invisible units and wards to any allied vision within 500 range of its carrier. 
Passive: Charge Loss
Loses a charge on death. After all charges are lost, the item disappears.

zh.name: 第三只眼
zh.desc:
被动：真实视域
 携带者自身和周围友方单位可以看见500范围内的隐身单位和守卫。
被动：能量丢失
每次阵亡后丢失一点能量，能量全部丢失后物品消失。

en.name: Leviathan's Fish
en.desc: Yummy Fish

zh.name: 利维坦的鱼
zh.desc: 可口的鱼

en.name: Tier 1 Token
en.desc: Activate to redeem a Tier 1 Neutral Item. The resulting neutral item isn't shareable and a hero can only redeem a single token per tier.

zh.name: 第1级代币
zh.desc: 使用后兑换一件第1级中立物品。兑换后的中立物品无法共享，而且每名英雄每一级代币只能兑换一枚。

zh.desc: 使用后兑换一件第3级中立物品。兑换后的中立物品无法共享，而且每名英雄每一级代币只能兑换一枚。

zh.desc: 使用后兑换一件第5级中立物品。兑换后的中立物品无法共享，而且每名英雄每一级代币只能兑换一枚。

en.name: Timeless Relic
en.desc: Increases all outgoing spell damage and debuff duration.

zh.name: 永恒遗物
zh.desc: 提升技能伤害和负面状态的持续时间。

en.name: Tome of Aghanim
en.desc:
Use: Consume
 Temporarily grants an allied target the Aghanim's Scepter buff for 3 minutes.

zh.name: 阿哈利姆之书
zh.desc:
使用：吞服
使友方目标暂时获得阿哈利姆神杖效果，持续3分钟。

en.name: Tome of Knowledge
en.desc:
Use: Enlighten
Grants you 750 experience plus 150 per tome consumed by your team after the first two.

Tomes Used By Team: %customval_team_tomes_used%

zh.name: 知识之书
zh.desc:
使用：启迪
直接获得750点经验值，而且己方在前两本书后每消耗一本知识之书，将额外获得150点经验。

己方已使用本数：%customval_team_tomes_used%

en.name: Town Portal Scroll
en.desc:
Use: Teleport
After channeling for 3 seconds, teleports you to a target friendly building. 

Double-click to teleport to your team's base fountain.
notes: If multiple heroes teleport to the same location in succession, the channeling time will be increased for each successive hero.
Teleport can be prevented or canceled by Root abilities.

zh.name: 回城卷轴
zh.desc:
使用：传送
经过3秒持续施法后传送到指定的友方建筑。

双击将直接传送至己方泉水。
notes: 如果多名英雄在短时间内接连传送至相同地点，那么后续英雄的传送时间都会相应地有所延长。
传送可以被缠绕类技能阻止或取消。

en.name: Tranquil Boots
en.desc:
Passive: Break
 Whenever you attack a hero or are attacked by any unit, the bonus 14 HP regen is lost and the movement speed bonus is reduced to 40 for 13 seconds.
Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.

zh.name: 静谧之鞋
zh.desc:
被动：破损
 只要主动攻击英雄或受到任何单位的攻击，静谧之鞋就会损失14点/秒回复效果，并且移动速度加成降低至40，持续13秒。
多个鞋类物品提供的移动速度加成不叠加。

en.name: Boots of Travel
en.desc:
Upgrade: Town Portal Scroll
Upgrades your Town Portal Scroll, allowing it to target units, reduces cooldown and does not consume a charge on usage. 
Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.

zh.name: 远行鞋
zh.desc:
升级：回城卷轴
使回城卷轴升级。可以对单位使用，降低冷却时间，并且使用时不会消耗次数。
多个鞋类物品提供的移动速度加成不叠加。

en.name: Boots of Travel 2
en.desc:
Upgrade: Town Portal Scroll
Upgrades your Town Portal Scroll, allowing it to target units and heroes, reduces cooldown, channel time and does not consume a charge on usage. 
Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.

zh.name: 远行鞋
zh.desc:
升级：回城卷轴
使回城卷轴升级。可以对单位和英雄使用，降低冷却时间，持续施法时间，并且使用时不会消耗次数。
多个鞋类物品提供的移动速度加成不叠加。
stats: 回城卷轴持续施法时间： 2

en.name: Trickster Cloak
en.desc:
Active: Cloak
Causes you to become invisible for 6 seconds.

zh.name: 欺诈师斗篷
zh.desc:
主动：隐形
使自己变为隐形状态，持续6秒。

en.name: Trident
en.desc: Combines Sange, Yasha and Kaya together.

zh.name: 三元重戟
zh.desc: 由散华，夜叉和慧光一起合成。

en.name: Trusty Shovel
en.desc:
Active: Dig
 Channel for 1 second. 
Can find a Bounty Rune, a Healing Salve, an Enchanted Mango, or a Kobold. If digging in a river, always digs up a Water Rune.
notes: 16% chance for a Bounty Rune.
28% chance each for a Flask, an Enchanted Mango, or a kobold.
The same Trusty Shovel cannot find the same reward twice in a row.

zh.name: 可靠铁铲
zh.desc:
主动：挖掘
持续施法1秒。
可以找到一个赏金神符，一瓶治疗药膏，一颗魔法芒果，或一个狗头人。如果在河道中挖掘，必定会挖出圣水神符。
notes: 16%几率挖出赏金神符。
28%几率分别挖出一瓶治疗药膏，一颗魔法芒果或一个狗头人。
同一把可靠铁铲不会连续两次挖出同一种奖励。

en.name: Aghanim's Scepter
en.desc:
Passive: Ability Upgrade
Upgrades the ultimate, and some abilities, of all heroes.

zh.name: 阿哈利姆神杖
zh.desc:
被动：技能升级
提升所有英雄的终极技能或基础技能效果。

en.name: Aghanim's Blessing
en.desc:
Passive: Ability Upgrade
Upgrades the ultimate, and some abilities, of all heroes.

zh.name: 阿哈利姆福佑
zh.desc:
被动：技能升级
提升所有英雄的终极技能或基础技能效果。

en.name: Aghanim's Blessing - Roshan
en.desc:
Passive: Ability Upgrade
Upgrades the ultimate, and some abilities, of all heroes.

zh.name: 阿哈利姆福佑 - 肉山
zh.desc:
被动：技能升级
提升所有英雄的终极技能或基础技能效果。

en.name: Unrelenting Eye
en.desc:
Passive: Relentless
Increases slow resistance by 50%. This bonus is reduced by 10% for every enemy hero within the wearer's attack radius.

zh.name: 不屈之眼
zh.desc:
被动：不屈
减速抗性提升50%。佩戴者的攻击距离内每出现一名敌方英雄就会使这个加成效果减少10%。

en.name: Pig Pole
en.desc:
Active: Pig, Out!
Turns your hero into a critter for 3 seconds and gives them +20% Movement Speed.

zh.name: 豚杆
zh.desc:
主动：小猪出动！
将拥有者变成一只小动物，持续3秒，并且提供+20%移动速度。

en.name: Unwavering Condition
en.desc:
Passive: Unwavering
 Hero's Max Health is set to 1800 and can't be altered by other effects or attributes.

zh.name: 坚毅之件
zh.desc:
被动：坚毅
英雄的最大生命值将定在1800点，不会因其他效果或属性而改变。

en.name: Urn of Shadows
en.desc:
Active: Soul Release
 Provides 30 health regeneration when cast on allies, and deals 25 damage per second when cast on enemies.

Lasts 8 seconds.

Gains charges every time an enemy hero dies within 1500 units.
notes: Empty urns gain 2 charges.
If the allied unit is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

zh.name: 影之灵龛
zh.desc:
主动：灵魂释放
 对友方单位施放时提供30点/秒生命恢复，对敌方单位则造成25点每秒伤害。持续8秒。

每当敌方英雄在1500范围内死亡时获得充能。
notes: 点数为0的灵龛将获得2点能量。
如果友方单位被敌方英雄或肉山攻击，效果将会消失。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

en.name: Vambrace
en.desc:
Active: Switch Attributes
Activate to switch the active attribute between Strength, Agility, and Intelligence. Vambrace provides +10 of the selected attribute and +4 of the other two attributes.

zh.name: 臂甲
zh.desc:
Active: Switch Attributes
Activate to switch the active attribute between Strength, Agility, and Intelligence. Vambrace provides +10 of the selected attribute and +4 of the other two attributes.

en.name: Vanguard
en.desc:
Passive: Damage Block
 Grants a 60% chance to block 50 damage from incoming attacks on melee heroes, and 25 damage on ranged.
notes: Multiple sources of damage block do not stack.

zh.name: 先锋盾
zh.desc:
被动：伤害格挡
 拥有60%几率格挡伤害，近战英雄可格挡50点伤害，远程英雄可格挡25点。
notes: 多种伤害格挡物品的效果互不叠加。

en.name: Veil of Discord
en.desc:
Active: Spell Weakness
 Cast a 900 radius blast that causes enemy heroes to take 10% increased damage from spells.

Can be cast while channeling.

Duration: 16 seconds.
notes: Spell Weakness does not stack with Bloodstone's Spell Weakness Aura.

zh.name: 纷争面纱
zh.desc:
主动：法术虚弱
发出一波弱化冲击，使900范围内敌方英雄受到的技能伤害增加10%。

可以在持续施法期间施放。

持续时间：16秒。
notes: 法术虚弱不与血精石的法术虚弱光环叠加。

en.name: Vindicator's Axe
en.desc:
Passive: Vengeance
 Provides 30 damage if equipped hero is Silenced and 20 armor if equipped hero is Stunned.

zh.name: 正义之斧
zh.desc:
被动：复仇
 装备的英雄被沉默时提供30点攻击力，被眩晕时提供20点护甲。

en.name: Vladmir's Offering
en.desc:
Passive: Vladmir's Aura
Grants 20% lifesteal, 18% bonus damage, 1 mana regeneration, and 2 armor to nearby allies.

Radius: 1200
notes: Lifesteal on attacks against creeps is reduced to 12%.

zh.name: 弗拉迪米尔的祭品
zh.desc:
被动：弗拉迪米尔光环
向周围队友提供20%吸血，18%攻击力加成，1点/秒魔法恢复和2点护甲。

作用范围：1200
notes: 攻击非英雄单位的吸血效果减少至12%。

en.name: Voodoo Mask
en.desc:
Passive: Spell Lifesteal
Heals the wearer for a percentage of spell damage dealt to enemies.
notes: Does not heal from Pure or Reflected damage.

zh.name: 巫毒面具
zh.desc:
被动：技能吸血
佩戴者每次对敌人造成技能伤害都将根据造成伤害的一定百分比回复生命值。
notes: 纯粹伤害或反弹伤害不会进行治疗。

en.name: Observer and Sentry Wards
en.desc:
Use: Plant
 Plant the currently active ward.  Double-Click to switch the currently active ward.
notes: Hold Control to give one ward to an allied hero.

zh.name: 侦察·岗哨守卫
zh.desc:
使用：放置
放置当前可用的守卫。双击守卫切换当前可用的守卫。
notes: 按住Ctrl键可以将一个守卫分给友方英雄。
stats: 岗哨守卫持续时间（分钟）： 8
岗哨守卫真实视域范围： 1050

en.name: Observer Ward
en.desc:
Use: Plant
Plants an Observer Ward, an invisible watcher that gives ground vision in a 1600 radius to your team. Lasts 6 minutes.

Hold Control to give one Observer Ward to an allied hero.

zh.name: 侦察守卫
zh.desc:
使用：放置
放置隐形的侦察守卫来获得附近区域1600范围内的视野。持续6分钟。

按住Ctrl键可以对友方英雄使用，将1个守卫转移到他的物品栏中。

en.name: Sentry Ward
en.desc:
Use: Plant
 Plants a Sentry Ward, an invisible watcher that grants True Sight, the ability to see invisible enemy units and wards, to any existing allied vision within a 1050 radius.
Lasts 7 minutes.

Does not grant ground vision.
Hold Control to give one Sentry Ward to an allied hero.

zh.name: 岗哨守卫
zh.desc:
使用：放置
放置隐形的岗哨守卫来为附近1050范围的区域提供真实视域。可以看到隐形的敌方单位和守卫。
持续7分钟。

本身不提供视野。
按住Ctrl键可以对友方英雄使用，将1个守卫转移到他的物品栏中。

en.name: Weighted Dice
en.desc:
Passive: Loaded
Increases your base damage maximum by 6. When calculating your base damage or creep bounty from last hits, the value is computed 2 times and the highest value is taken.

zh.name: 加重骰子
zh.desc:
被动：欺诈
最高基础攻击力提升6点。在计算佩戴者针对正补的基础伤害或小兵赏金时，数值会计算2次，并取较高值。

en.name: Whisper of the Dread
en.desc:
Passive: Tunnel Vision
 Equipped Hero has their daytime vision reduced by 15% but their Spell damage increased by 10%.

zh.name: 邪道私语
zh.desc:
被动：孔中窥人
佩戴者的白天视野减少15%，但是技能伤害提升10%。

en.name: Wind Lace
en.desc: Bonuses from multiple Wind Laces do not stack.

zh.name: 风灵之纹
zh.desc: 多个风灵之纹的加成效果不会叠加。

en.name: Wind Waker
en.desc:
Active: Cyclone
 Sweeps a target unit up into a cyclone, making them invulnerable for 2.5 seconds. Cyclone can be cast on yourself, enemy units or allied units. When cast on yourself, you can move the tornado at a speed of 300.

Enemy units take 50 magical damage upon landing.
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
notes: Cyclone can dispel some buffs and debuffs.
When cast on yourself, the cyclone can be moved anywhere at a speed of 360.
Cyclone duration is unaffected by status resistance.

zh.name: 风之杖
zh.desc:
主动：龙卷风
使目标单位被卷入龙卷风中，持续2.5秒，并处于无敌状态。可以对自身、敌方单位或友方单位使用龙卷风。对自身使用后，自身能使龙卷风以300的移速进行移动。

敌方单位落地后将受到50点魔法伤害。
驱散类型：弱驱散
notes: 龙卷风可以驱散部分正面和负面状态。
对自身施放时，龙卷风可以任意移动，移动速度为360。
龙卷风持续时间不受状态抗性影响。

en.name: Witch Blade
en.desc:
Passive: Witch Blade
Causes your next attack to apply a poison for 4 seconds, slowing by 25% and dealing 0.75x your intelligence as damage every second. This attack has True Strike.

zh.name: 巫师之刃
zh.desc:
被动：巫师之刃
使下次攻击施加毒素，持续4秒，减缓25%移动速度，并且每秒造成0.75倍智力值的伤害。本次攻击具有克敌机先效果。

en.name: Witless Shako
en.desc: Increases the wearer's max health, while reducing their max mana.

zh.name: 无知小帽
zh.desc: 提升了穿戴者的最大生命值，但减少了最大魔法值。

en.name: Woodland Striders
en.desc:
Active: Woodland Stride
 Create a path of trees behind you for 3 seconds. Trees last up to 15 seconds. 
Passive: Tree Walking
 Removes movement speed limit and allows free pathing through trees.
 
Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.

zh.name: 林地神行靴
zh.desc:
主动：林地神行
在身后创造一条全是树木的路，持续3秒。树木最多持续15秒。
被动：树木穿行
突破移动速度上限，在树林间可以自由穿行。
 
多个鞋类物品的移动速度加成不会叠加。

en.name: Yasha
notes: Yasha-based movement speed bonuses from multiple items do not stack.

zh.name: 夜叉
notes: 不会与其他夜叉、散夜对剑以及幻影斧提供的移动速度加成叠加。
